Quitting without saving forfeits.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
text: In a Battle Swap event, you may use only three POKéMON. / Whether you are renting or swapping, your team may not have two or more of the same POKéMON.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
text: You may swap POKéMON only with the TRAINER you have just defeated. / You may swap for only those POKéMON used by the beaten TRAINER.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
text: After every battle you win, you may swap for one of your defeated opponent's POKéMON. / You will not be able to swap POKéMON with the third TRAINER in the event.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
text: There are two key points to be aware of when swapping POKéMON. / First, when swapping, you can't check the stats of the POKéMON you are about to receive. / Second, the POKéMON on your team are lined up in sequence, depending on the order in which you rented them. / This sequence remains unchanged even when swaps are made.$

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
text: Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT, POKéMON are required to think and battle by themselves. / Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
text: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may prefer to attack no matter what. / Another POKéMON may prefer to protect itself from any harm. / Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes. / Depending on its nature, a POKéMON will have favorite moves that it is good at using. / It may also dislike certain moves that it has trouble using.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
text: There are offensive moves that inflict direct damage on the foe. / There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on. / There are also other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foes with stat problems including poison and  paralysis. / POKéMON will consider using moves in these three categories.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
text: When not under command by its TRAINER, a POKéMON may be unable to effectively use certain moves. / A POKéMON is not good at using any move that it dislikes. / If a POKéMON only knows moves that do not match its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.$

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
text: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble. / If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.$

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
text: At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of your opponents will be adjusted to match the levels of your POKéMON. / However, no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 30.$

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
text: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting! / Welcome to the world of POKéMON! / My name is BIRCH. / But everyone calls me the POKéMON PROFESSOR. / $

label: gText_Birch_Pokemon
text: This is what we call a “POKéMON.” /  $

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
text: This world is widely inhabited by creatures known as POKéMON. / But this HOENN is a little different. Here, POKéMON are built, not raised. / Let me walk you through it. First, catch POKéMON. Lots of them. / Every one has perfect potential and comes with a competitive BATTLE SET already on it. / Wild POKéMON from every region live throughout HOENN. Some legendary discoveries are 1% wild encounters. / SWEET SCENT gives a 25% chance of an available local legendary. / Shared areas split that chance evenly. Badges and story requirements apply. / The REPEL SPRAY keeps the rest away while you travel. / Next, level them. The LEVELER raises your whole team to the level cap instantly, as often as you like. / The cap rises with each BADGE. There is no grinding. Ever. / BADGES also unlock CUT, SURF and the rest. Any POKéMON in your party that could learn one can use it. / The FLIGHT BEACON calls a ride the moment you can FLY. / Then build them. Every POKéMON CENTER has a TUTOR. Talk to them. / The TUTOR teaches any move that POKéMON can learn. / The TUTOR changes its NATURE. Its ABILITY you can change yourself, right from the party menu. / The TUTOR edits its EVs: 510 to spend, up to 252 per stat. Their effect scales with level. / The TUTOR shows the stat as you spend, so tune it. Don't guess. / Or skip all that and pick a BATTLE SET: moves, NATURE, held item and EVs in one choice. / Held items are free from the VENDOR in every POKéMON CENTER. / All of it is free. Change it anytime. / Then battle. Battles are mostly DOUBLES, and TRAINERS play to win. / When you pick a move, press L to see the foes' types. R shows the move. / You will lose sometimes. That's the point, not the end. / Save before a big battle. If you lose, choose RELOAD in the menu and retry. / Catch. Level. Build. Battle. Then build again, better. / Think of it as POKéMON CHAMPIONS, played across all of HOENN. / That's what I do here now: I help TRAINERS build. So, let's begin. / $

text: On the top floor, there are two rooms. / First, the room on the left. It's the UNION ROOM. / You may link up with TRAINERS around you who have also entered the UNION ROOM. / With them, you may do things like chat, battle, and trade. / Second, the room on the right is the DIRECT CORNER. / You may trade or battle POKéMON with your friends in this room. / If the Wireless Adapter isn't connected, you may still link up using a GBA Game Link cable. / If that is the case, you must go to the DIRECT CORNER. / I hope you enjoy the Wireless  Communication System.$

label: gText_EmeraldChampionsFirstCenterVisit

label: gText_EmeraldChampionsExplainTools
text: The Poké Vial fully restores your party outside battle. / It holds one dose, and every Pokémon Center refills it for free. / The Leveler raises your whole party to the current level cap. / It never runs out. Use it whenever you want to prepare a new team. / The Repel Spray keeps wild Pokémon away for 500 steps per use. / Fishing, Rock Smash and Sweet Scent still work. / And meet my neighbors! The Tutor by the PC builds your team: moves, Nature, EVs and Battle Sets. / The Vendor beside me has every held item, free. Every Center has us both. / The Flight Beacon calls a flier to carry you, once you have the badge for Fly.$

label: gText_EmeraldChampionsGiveMissingRepelSpray

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4DeclineBattle
text: I guess there are times when you're not into it.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Defeated
text: I know exactly what you're made of now.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PostBattle
text: We can both become stronger. Let's keep at it!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion
text: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up with my favorite decorations. / I raise my favorite POKéMON and grow stronger with it. / Every day is a great day.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro
text: You can learn a lot about the taste and sense of people by the kinds of decorations they have, and how they display them. / What do you think of my taste? Are you speechless? / Want to see my taste in battling?$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9AcceptBattle
text: There's no holding back!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9DeclineBattle
text: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style anytime.$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Defeated
text: You're supremely talented! Your power seems to be limitless…$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PostBattle
text: What did you think of my style? I'll keep on polishing it!$

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PreChampion
text: You can learn a lot about the taste and sense of people by the kinds of decorations they have, and how they display them. / What do you think of my taste? Are you speechless?$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYouPlanningOnGoingInThere
text: Are you planning on going deep in there? / How about bringing me back some SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS? / I can make you something good if you bring me the ingredients.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
text: Bring me four each of SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS, and I can weave a reusable LINKING CORD.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
text: Oh, hey! You found enough SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS! / Would you like me to weave them into a LINKING CORD?$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
text: All right! I'll make that LINKING CORD right away. / … … … … … … … … There! Done!$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
text: This reusable LINKING CORD lets certain POKéMON evolve without a trade.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WantedToMakeShellBell
text: Oh… Is that so? I wanted to weave a LINKING CORD…$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
text: There is no room in your KEY ITEMS pocket. Make space and come back.$

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AlreadyHasLinkingCord
text: You already have the LINKING CORD I made. It is reusable, so one is enough.$

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoalSaltNowNothing
text: There was some SHOAL SALT here. But, there's nothing here now.$

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoallShellNowNothing
text: There was a SHOAL SHELL here. But, there's nothing here now.$

label: gText_WantToUseSurf
text: The water is dyed a deep blue… Would you like to SURF?$

label: gText_PlayerUsedSurf
text: {STR_VAR_1} used SURF!$

label: Text_CurrentTooFast
text: The current is much too fast! SURF can't be used here…$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinIntro
text: If you have POKéMON with you, then you're an official POKéMON TRAINER! You can't say no to my challenge!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinDefeated
text: Arrgh, I lost… I should have trained mine more…$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinPostBattle
text: Listen, you. If you're strong, you should have told me before!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
text: I've been working hard at this since I saw you before. / I want to keep comparing training notes. Register me in your POKéNAV!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegisterShort
text: Let's compare training notes. Register me in your POKéNAV!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
text: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately trained my POKéMON. You can't say no to my challenge!$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchDefeated
text: Arrgh, I lost… Is my training method not right?$

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchPostBattle
text: If you're going to get stronger, I'll get stronger, too.$

label: Route102_Text_AllenIntro
text: Did you just become a TRAINER? We're both beginners!$

label: Route102_Text_AllenDefeated
text: I called you because I thought I could beat you…$

label: Route102_Text_AllenPostBattle
text: I haven't won once yet… I wish I would win soon…$

label: Route102_Text_RickIntro
text: Hahah! Our eyes met! I'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!$

label: Route102_Text_RickDefeated
text: Ow! Down and out!$

label: Route102_Text_RickPostBattle
text: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER, you have to challenge! It's a rule!$

label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
text: I'm going to keep winning and aim to be the best TRAINER. / Help me further my career!$

label: Route102_Text_TianaDefeated
text: I ended up furthering your career…$

label: Route102_Text_TianaPostBattle
text: To keep winning my way up, I see that I have to catch more POKéMON.$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyIntro
text: Did you feel the tug of our soul-soothing fragrance?$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyDefeated
text: You weren't led astray by our aroma…$

label: Route103_Text_DaisyPostBattle
text: Aromatherapy is a form of mental healing that works with fragrances.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyIntro
text: AMY: I'm AMY. And this is my little sister LIV. We battle together!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyDefeated
text: AMY: Uh-oh, we lost.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyPostBattle
text: AMY: You have to think about all kinds of things when you're battling against two TRAINERS.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyNotEnoughPokemon
text: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one POKéMON with you. You can't battle us like that.$

label: Route103_Text_LivIntro
text: LIV: We battle together as one team.$

label: Route103_Text_LivDefeated
text: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister…$

label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
text: LIV: We work perfectly together, me and my big sister… / But we still lost…$

label: Route103_Text_AmyLivRegister
text: LIV: Really, we're getting better… Your teamwork gave us new ideas!$

label: Route103_Text_LivNotEnoughPokemon
text: LIV: If you want to battle us, you have to have two POKéMON! It's not fair if you don't!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchIntro
text: AMY: I'm AMY. And this is my little sister LIV. We battle together!$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchDefeated
text: AMY: Aww, boo! We couldn't win again…$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchPostBattle
text: AMY: You have to think about all kinds of things when you're battling against two TRAINERS.$

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchNotEnoughPokemon
text: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one POKéMON with you. You can't battle us like that.$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchIntro
text: LIV: We battle together as one team.$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchDefeated
text: LIV: Awww, we lost again… Big sister…$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
text: LIV: We work perfectly together, me and my big sister… / But why did we lose again?$

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchNotEnoughPokemon
text: LIV: If you want to battle us, you have to have two POKéMON! It's not fair if you don't!$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewIntro
text: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up! I'm getting frustrated and mean! That's it! Battle me!$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewDefeated
text: Gah! Lost it! I'm even more annoyed now!$

label: Route103_Text_AndrewPostBattle
text: Gah, I'm still boiling mad… Grrrrr…$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelIntro
text: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable! Don't be shy--I'll show you!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelDefeated
text: Oh, my gosh! My darling POKéMON!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelPostBattle
text: My delightful POKéMON looks darling even when it's fainted!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRegister
text: I'll get you to come out and look in on my delightful POKéMON again!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchIntro
text: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable POKéMON has become more darling!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchDefeated
text: Oh! My darling POKéMON!$

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchPostBattle
text: The more I spend time with it, the more adorable my POKéMON becomes.$

label: Route103_Text_PeteIntro
text: This sort of distance… You should just swim it!$

label: Route103_Text_PeteDefeated
text: Oh, that's good going!$

label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
text: Oh, I understand where you're coming from now. / If I had a POKéMON that trusty, I'd want to SURF on it, too!$

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleIntro
text: Watch where you're going! We're going to crash!$

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleDefeated
text: Groan…$

label: Route103_Text_IsabellePostBattle
text: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing… Sorry for almost crashing into you.$

label: Route103_Text_RhettIntro
text: Whoa! How'd you get into a space this small?$

label: Route103_Text_RhettDefeated
text: Whoa! The kid can rock!$

label: Route103_Text_RhettPostBattle
text: Do you like cramped quarters like this?$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosIntro
text: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosDefeated
text: My one-man show is ruined…$

label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
text: I was playing my guitar where few people were around, but a lot of fans have gathered. / Heh, maybe I should turn pro.$

label: Route104_Text_GinaIntro
text: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our POKéMON!$

label: Route104_Text_GinaDefeat
text: GINA: Losing upsets me!$

label: Route104_Text_GinaPostBattle
text: GINA: You are strong! We have to train lots more!$

label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
text: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON? Then, we don't battle with you. / If there's only one POKéMON, it will be lonesome. That's not nice.$

label: Route104_Text_MiaIntro
text: MIA: We are twins, so we battle POKéMON together.$

label: Route104_Text_MiaDefeat
text: MIA: We battled together, but we both lost…$

label: Route104_Text_MiaPostBattle
text: MIA: We will train our POKéMON more and be strong like you.$

label: Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
text: MIA: You want to battle with us? / It's a big no-no if you don't have two POKéMON with you. We're too strong for you!$

label: Route104_Text_IvanIntro
text: Why keep it a secret? I'm the WATER POKéMON expert! / Huh? You don't know me?$

label: Route104_Text_IvanDefeat
text: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may say so, but I guess not… Bleah…$

label: Route104_Text_IvanPostBattle
text: I got too into fishing. I forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…$

label: Route104_Text_BillyIntro
text: Leaving footprints in the sand is so fun!$

label: Route104_Text_BillyDefeat
text: Waah! I got sand in my runners! They're all gritty!$

label: Route104_Text_BillyPostBattle
text: I want to leave my footprints in the sand everywhere, but they disappear quickly…$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyIntro
text: Should I… Or shouldn't I? / Okay, sure, I will battle!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyDefeat
text: I shouldn't have battled…$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostBattle
text: If you're faced with a decision and you let someone else choose for you, you will regret it, however things turn out.$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1
text: You're strong, but should I register you in my POKéNAV? Maybe I shouldn't… / Okay, sure, I will register you!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2
text: You're strong, but should I register you in my POKéNAV? Maybe I shouldn't… / Okay, sure, I will register you!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
text: Come on, battle with me!$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchDefeat
text: Ohh… I thought I could win…$

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch
text: I made the decision to battle, so I can accept this loss with grace. / I am still upset about losing!$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonIntro
text: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge. I have a lot of money.$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonDefeat
text: Why couldn't I win?$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostBattle
text: There are some things money can't buy. That's POKéMON…$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1
text: Hm? Ah, you've obtained a POKéNAV. / I will gladly register you. After all, I have plenty of money.$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2
text: Hm? Ah, you've obtained a POKéNAV. / I will gladly register you. After all, I have plenty of money.$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchIntro
text: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch of things about POKéMON.$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchDefeat
text: I lost again? Why couldn't I win?$

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch
text: I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't seem to win at POKéMON… / It's so deep, the world of POKéMON…$

label: Route104_Text_CindyIntro
text: We must have been fated to meet. May I ask you for a battle?$

label: Route104_Text_CindyDefeat
text: Oh, my!$

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostBattle
text: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.” I hope we meet again.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister1
text: Hello, we meet again. / We seem to be drawn together. Let's register each other in our POKéNAVS.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister2
text: We should commemorate how we seem to be drawn to each other. / Let's register each other in our POKéNAVS.$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchIntro
text: Hello, we meet again. May I ask you for a battle?$

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchDefeat
text: Oh, my… I did the best that I could…$

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostRematch
text: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.” I hope we meet again.$

label: Route104_Text_DarianIntro
text: I fished up a tough-looking POKéMON! / It has this magical quality to it! It surely looks tough, yes it does!$

label: Route104_Text_DarianDefeat
text: What the…$

label: Route104_Text_DarianPostBattle
text: Every catch has a different trick. I still have plenty to learn.$

label: Route105_Text_FosterIntro
text: There's supposed to be a mystical rock around here. Do you know anything about it?$

label: Route105_Text_FosterDefeated
text: I was thinking too much about that rock, while my POKéMON remained weak…$

label: Route105_Text_FosterPostBattle
text: I can spend hours and hours staring at a nice rock without growing bored.$

label: Route105_Text_LuisIntro
text: Whew! I was worried that a kid was drowning when I saw you. / You seem to be okay, so what do you say to a battle?$

label: Route105_Text_LuisDefeated
text: Glub… Glub…$

label: Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle
text: If you are drowning, the signal is to wave one arm toward the beach.$

label: Route105_Text_DominikIntro
text: Swimming the deep blue sea… It feels the greatest!$

label: Route105_Text_DominikDefeated
text: I lost… Now I'm feeling blue…$

label: Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle
text: Why is the sea blue? / I learned about that at the MUSEUM in SLATEPORT, but I forgot.$

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyIntro
text: My body feels lighter in the water. It's as if I've gotten slimmer!$

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyDefeated
text: I'm floating…$

label: Route105_Text_PostBattle
text: Your body weight is reduced to just one tenth in the water. / That would make me… Whoops! I'm not telling you my weight!$

label: Route105_Text_ImaniIntro
text: The blue, blue sky… The vast sea… It's so peaceful…$

label: Route105_Text_ImaniDefeated
text: I lost while I was lounging!$

label: Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle
text: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be with. Giggle.$

label: Route105_Text_AndresIntro
text: I'm convinced that the sea keeps secrets from us.$

label: Route105_Text_AndresDefeated
text: Yes… I am no good at battling…$

label: Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle
text: I'm sure there are many secrets to be discovered in the world's seas. / I mean to find them all!$

label: Route105_Text_AndresRegister
text: Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing to register me in your POKéNAV?$

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchIntro
text: I've told you that I'm weak… Are you sure you want to do this?$

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchDefeated
text: Yes… I didn't think I could win.$

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle
text: I may be weak at battling, but my drive to explore can't be bested. / I will travel the seas all around the world!$

label: Route105_Text_JosueIntro
text: I'm exhausted from swimming. I'm just not used to it. / I need a battle for a change of pace!$

label: Route105_Text_JosueDefeated
text: I lost because I battled at sea.$

label: Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle
text: Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better match than the sea.$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotIntro
text: Which do you prefer, fishing in the sea or a stream?$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotDefeated
text: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost spectacularly!$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle
text: Fishing is the greatest whether it's in the sea or a stream. You agree with me, right?$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRegister
text: Fishing's great, but so is battling. If you don't mind, can we meet again?$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
text: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing. I'll show you an impressive battle!$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchDefeated
text: I lost again spectacularly!$

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle
text: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest! You agree with me, right?$

label: Route106_Text_NedIntro
text: What do people do if they need to go to a washroom? / What if my ROD hooks a big one while I'm in the washroom? I just can't go…$

label: Route106_Text_NedDefeated
text: I lost because I'm trying to not go to the washroom…$

label: Route106_Text_NedPostBattle
text: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook a big one!$

label: Route106_Text_DouglasIntro
text: Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in the water you can't catch me!$

label: Route106_Text_DouglasDefeated
text: I give up!$

label: Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle
text: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…$

label: Route106_Text_KylaIntro
text: The sea is my backyard. I'm not going to take it easy because you're a kid!$

label: Route106_Text_KylaDefeated
text: Did you take it easy on me by any chance?$

label: Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle
text: Drifting along with the waves… I love it! Why don't you give it a try?$

label: Route107_Text_DarrinIntro
text: Yawn… / I must have drifted off to sleep while I was drifting in the waves.$

label: Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated
text: Ahaha, I lost… I'll take a snooze, I think…$

label: Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle
text: Floating and being rocked by the waves--it's like sleeping in a plush, comfy bed.$

label: Route107_Text_TonyIntro
text: The sea is like my backyard. Let's battle!$

label: Route107_Text_TonyDefeated
text: I lost on my home field… I'm in shock!$

label: Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle
text: I swim the seas with a heart full of dreams… / It's a song! Anyways, I'm swimming some more.$

label: Route107_Text_TonyRegister
text: You've shocked me to the bone! Well, so you won't forget me…$

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchIntro
text: Swimming in the big, wide sea, my POKéMON has grown stronger!$

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated
text: What a shock! / My POKéMON has gotten stronger, but I stayed weak as a TRAINER!$

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle
text: What you learn in battle makes you a stronger TRAINER. The waves taught me that.$

label: Route107_Text_DeniseIntro
text: Do you know a little town called DEWFORD?$

label: Route107_Text_DeniseDefeated
text: I hate this!$

label: Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle
text: A weird saying is getting really trendy at DEWFORD HALL.$

label: Route107_Text_BethIntro
text: Did you want to battle me? Sure, I'll go with you!$

label: Route107_Text_BethDefeated
text: I wasn't good enough for you.$

label: Route107_Text_BethPostBattle
text: I think you're going to keep getting better. I'll go for it, too!$

label: Route107_Text_LisaIntro
text: LISA: We challenge you as a sister and brother!$

label: Route107_Text_LisaDefeated
text: LISA: Awesome. You're in a different class of tough.$

label: Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle
text: LISA: Do you have any friends who would go to the beach with you?$

label: Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon
text: LISA: If you want to battle with us, bring more POKéMON.$

label: Route107_Text_RayIntro
text: RAY: We always battle POKéMON, me and my sister. / I always lose, but we can beat you 2-on-2!$

label: Route107_Text_RayDefeated
text: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level than us!$

label: Route107_Text_RayPostBattle
text: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON. I raised it, and now it's my important partner!$

label: Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon
text: RAY: If you want to battle us, go bring some more POKéMON!$

label: Route107_Text_CamronIntro
text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but I'm nowhere near tired!$

label: Route107_Text_CamronDefeated
text: That exhausted me…$

label: Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle
text: I still have swimming and running left to do after this. / Am I going to be okay?$

label: Route108_Text_JeromeIntro
text: My dream is to swim the world's seven seas!$

label: Route108_Text_JeromeDefeated
text: I won't be able to swim the seven seas like this…$

label: Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle
text: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of the pleasures of swimming!$

label: Route108_Text_MatthewIntro
text: Ahoy, there! Are you going out to the ABANDONED SHIP, too?$

label: Route108_Text_MatthewDefeated
text: I'm sinking! Glub… Glub…$

label: Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle
text: Some people even go inside that ABANDONED SHIP.$

label: Route108_Text_TaraIntro
text: My liar of a boyfriend told me that I look great in a bikini…$

label: Route108_Text_TaraDefeated
text: Oh, boo!$

label: Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle
text: Even if it's a lie, I love being told I look great… We girls are so complex…$

label: Route108_Text_MissyIntro
text: I love the sea! I forget all my worries when I swim!$

label: Route108_Text_MissyDefeated
text: When I lose a battle, I get all stressed out!$

label: Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle
text: Work off your stress by swimming! It's so healthy!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryIntro
text: I love WATER-type POKéMON. I love other POKéMON, too!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryDefeated
text: Waaah! I lost! Waaah! Waaah!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle
text: Shouting is good for me! It uplifts me!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryRegister
text: I love tough TRAINERS, too! Register me in your POKéNAV!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchIntro
text: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchDefeated
text: Waaah! I lost again! Waaah! Waaah!$

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle
text: If you're faced with a challenge, try shouting at the sea!$

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaIntro
text: LUXRAY and HAWLUCHA, one speedy battle. I take pride in this team.$

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaDefeated
text: That wasn't cute at all.$

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle
text: Out here on the water, I could wear something pink and frilly and nobody would blink. Focus, Carolina.$

label: Route109_Text_DavidIntro
text: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs! This is what you call “cut”!$

label: Route109_Text_DavidDefeated
text: Aiyah! Flubbed out!$

label: Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle
text: Hiyah! / My sculpted abs have nothing to do with POKéMON battles!$

label: Route109_Text_AliceIntro
text: Are you properly protected against the sun?$

label: Route109_Text_AliceDefeated
text: Ouch, ouch, ouch!$

label: Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle
text: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!$

label: Route109_Text_HueyIntro
text: I've laid anchor in ports around the world, but SLATEPORT's the best.$

label: Route109_Text_HueyDefeated
text: You're the best!$

label: Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle
text: In the best port was the best TRAINER…$

label: Route109_Text_EdmondIntro
text: Urrrrppp… Battle? With me?$

label: Route109_Text_EdmondDefeated
text: Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh… Urrrrpppp…$

label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
text: I'm usually stronger than this! I'm just seasick as a dog! / I'm a SAILOR, but…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyIntro
text: I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP at the SEASHORE HOUSE…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyDefeated
text: Groan…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle
text: I'm getting famished… My inner tube looks like a giant doughnut…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyRegister
text: Call me sometime when I'm not all thirsty, okay?$

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro
text: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in me for a battle!$

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchDefeated
text: I lost… It's because I'm hungry…$

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle
text: When you eat on a beach, everything seems to taste a little better.$

label: Route109_Text_LolaIntro
text: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like a giant flower?$

label: Route109_Text_LolaDefeated
text: Mommy!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle
text: If you look at the beach from the sky, it looks like a big flower garden!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaRegister
text: Me? I'm here every day!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro
text: I'm not losing to you again! That's why I have my inner tube!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchDefeated
text: Mommy!$

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle
text: If I have an inner tube, me and my POKéMON's cuteness goes way up!$

label: Route109_Text_AustinaIntro
text: I can't swim without my inner tube, but I won't lose at POKéMON!$

label: Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated
text: Did I lose because I have an inner tube?$

label: Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle
text: My inner tube is a fashion item. I can't be seen without it.$

label: Route109_Text_GwenIntro
text: Hi, big TRAINER. Will you battle with me?$

label: Route109_Text_GwenDefeated
text: Oh, you're strong.$

label: Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle
text: How did you get to be so strong?$

label: Route109_Text_CarterIntro
text: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch himself a big one!$

label: Route109_Text_CarterDefeated
text: This dude just lost one…$

label: Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle
text: This dude thinks you're a big one. No, you're a big-one-to-be!$

label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
text: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker. / I wish you wouldn't disturb our precious time together.$

label: Route109_Text_PaulDefeated
text: PAUL: Well, I give up.$

label: Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle
text: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that we're here. This is just our private world of two!$

label: Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon
text: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love. That's why we make our POKéMON battle together.$

label: Route109_Text_MelIntro
text: MEL: We're, like, totally in love. Our romance is heating up all of HOENN!$

label: Route109_Text_MelDefeated
text: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault! PAUL will hate me!$

label: Route109_Text_MelPostBattle
text: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me? Please don't be angry.$

label: Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon
text: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love. That's why we make our POKéMON battle together.$

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerIntro
text: Tadaah! See? My inner tube's round!$

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerDefeated
text: Oh, oh! Too bad!$

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle
text: After I showed you my round inner tube, too…$

label: Route109_Text_HaileyIntro
text: I can't swim, so I'm pretending to swim.$

label: Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated
text: I thought so! I didn't think we could win.$

label: Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle
text: When I learn how to swim, I think my POKéMON will become tougher.$

label: Route109_Text_ElijahIntro
text: For a guy as macho as me, this kind of POKéMON is the perfect match!$

label: Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated
text: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?$

label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
text: For a guy as macho as me, a port is the perfect setting! / I guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.$

label: Route110_Text_JacobIntro
text: Whoa! Watch it! I guess you're not used to BIKE racing.$

label: Route110_Text_JacobDefeated
text: Whoa! My brakes failed!$

label: Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle
text: Flat tires and brake problems can cause serious injury! Inspect your BIKE for problems!$

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro
text: Yo, you! Can you keep up with my speed?$

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyDefeated
text: Crash and burn!$

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
text: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON. I need to reconsider this…$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro
text: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminDefeated
text: I shouldn't panic during POKéMON battles…$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
text: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister
text: I'll keep chugging on without stressing. Give me a shout if you're up to it.$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
text: Aren't you going a little too fast? Take it easy and let's battle.$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated
text: I didn't panic, but I still lost…$

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle
text: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
text: The triathlon is hard in the extreme. / You have to complete the three events of swimming, cycling, and running.$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailDefeated
text: POKéMON battles are hard, too!$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle
text: I'm exhausted, so I need a break. It's important to get proper rest.$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRegister
text: You know, I like you! Let's swap tips about CYCLING ROAD.$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
text: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while cycling?$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated
text: Wow… How could you be so strong?$

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
text: Were you going after a record? / I'm sorry if I held you up!$

label: Route110_Text_JasmineIntro
text: I've been riding without stopping. My thighs are like rocks!$

label: Route110_Text_JasmineDefeated
text: I'm worried about muscle cramps…$

label: Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle
text: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES? No wonder you're so strong!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwardIntro
text: I have foreseen your intentions! I cannot possibly lose!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated
text: I failed to prophesize my own demise!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
text: I see your future… / Hmm… I see a shining light…$

label: Route110_Text_JaclynIntro
text: Ahahahaha! I'll dazzle you with my wonders!$

label: Route110_Text_JaclynDefeated
text: I wondrously lost!$

label: Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle
text: You managed to win only because it was a wonder! Yes, a wonder! Don't think you can win all the time!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinIntro
text: Could I see your POKéMON? Just one look, please?$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinDefeated
text: I wanted to complete my collection…$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle
text: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know, my passion as a collector is ignited!$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRegister
text: I like collecting MATCH CALL registrations, too…$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
text: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON? / Could I see your POKéMON? Just one look, please?$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchDefeated
text: Your POKéMON… I envy you.$

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle
text: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON mine!$

label: Route110_Text_DaleIntro
text: Hey! Don't sneak up behind me like that!$

label: Route110_Text_DaleDefeated
text: I lost! Drat!$

label: Route110_Text_DalePostBattle
text: Fishing is all about concentration. You have to focus on the floater.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelIntro
text: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show off my delightful POKéMON.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelDefeated
text: Oh, dear, this won't do.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle
text: Rather than battling, perhaps I should show off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
text: That wasn't close to what I could do to show off my POKéMON. / I'll have you as my captive audience as often as possible!$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchIntro
text: Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show off my POKéMON as often as you like!$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchDefeated
text: Oh, dear, this won't do.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle
text: I don't think that I could ever stop from showing off my POKéMON. / But I like to battle, too!$

label: Route110_Text_TimmyIntro
text: I found some cool POKéMON in the grass around here!$

label: Route110_Text_TimmyDefeated
text: Being cool isn't enough to win…$

label: Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle
text: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you just caught.$

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro
text: I fell off CYCLING ROAD… / I'll get over my embarrassment by battling with you!$

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaDefeated
text: Oops! I ended up losing!$

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle
text: Falling… Losing… This is so humiliating for me!$

label: Route110_Text_JosephIntro
text: Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can't groove, you get left behind!$

label: Route110_Text_JosephDefeated
text: You got into the groove all right…$

label: Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle
text: This isn't going to bring me down! Losing has made me a better man!$

label: Route110_Text_KalebIntro
text: When cute POKéMON help each other… You won't see a more adorable sight!$

label: Route110_Text_KalebDefeated
text: Have you no compassion or pity?$

label: Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle
text: Okay, okay, you've done the best you could, my pretties.$

label: Route111_Text_DrewIntro
text: Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you. But I think they look better on me. / Let's decide who they look better on with a battle!$

label: Route111_Text_DrewDefeat
text: I couldn't see what was happening at my sides because of the GO-GOGGLES.$

label: Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle
text: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to get through sandstorms. That makes me happy!$

label: Route111_Text_HeidiIntro
text: I'm having a picnic in the desert. / You can always find a TRAINER, so I can enjoy a battle here, too!$

label: Route111_Text_HeidiDefeat
text: Ohhh! You're mean!$

label: Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle
text: When you're battling in a sandstorm, watch out for your POKéMON's HP. / It can faint if you don't keep an eye on it!$

label: Route111_Text_BeauIntro
text: Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me feel like a superhero. Right now, nobody can beat me!$

label: Route111_Text_BeauDefeat
text: I can't win on spirit alone…$

label: Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle
text: I'm going to be a real hero one day. I'm going to work harder to make me and my POKéMON stronger.$

label: Route111_Text_BeckyIntro
text: I heard there are fossils to be found in the desert. Where could they be?$

label: Route111_Text_BeckyDefeat
text: I came up short…$

label: Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle
text: If they can find fossils in the desert, it must have been a sea before.$

label: Route111_Text_DustyIntro
text: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins! I am to be challenged?$

label: Route111_Text_DustyDefeat
text: While I have searched for ruins, I've not searched for strong POKéMON.$

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle
text: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins! / No, wait, was that forty years? Which was it now?$

label: Route111_Text_DustyRegister
text: I haven't been searching for any tough POKéMON. / But, for some reason, I sure do like POKéNAVS.$

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro
text: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins! / No, wait, was that forty years? Anyway, am I to be challenged?$

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchDefeat
text: I've found no ruins, nor have I found any strong POKéMON…$

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
text: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins! / No, wait, was that forty years I've searched? / Hmm… It could even be fifty… How long have I been at this?$

label: Route111_Text_TravisIntro
text: I'm full of pep! And my POKéMON is peppy, too!$

label: Route111_Text_TravisDefeat
text: My POKéMON lost its pep…$

label: Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle
text: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep, I can't help looking.$

label: Route111_Text_IreneIntro
text: I don't know where you're going, but would you like to battle?$

label: Route111_Text_IreneDefeat
text: Oh, you're disgustingly good!$

label: Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle
text: I'm thinking that I should go to MT. CHIMNEY, but the view around here is very nice, too.$

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeIntro
text: To train myself, I challenge all whom I meet!$

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeDefeat
text: Uncle! I give up!$

label: Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle
text: All I can do is keep training until I can defeat strong TRAINERS such as yourself.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonIntro
text: COFAGRIGUS gives your attacker MUMMY, then STEELIX cleans what's left. / Show me a team that doesn't need to touch it.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonDefeat
text: You never touched the coffin.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle
text: Contact moves are a habit. Break the habit before a Ghost breaks your team.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
text: There is much to be learned from your training style. / I request permission to record your contact, if it behooves you.$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
text: We're training here to elevate our game to the next level. Stay and train with us!$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchDefeat
text: Ooh, you're decent!$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch
text: Since you're that strong, you should aim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeIntro
text: Four roles. BLASTOISE holds, INFERNAPE leads, EXEGGUTOR sleeps, RAIKOU finishes. / Which one do you answer first?$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeDefeat
text: You picked the right one.$

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle
text: Every role has a counter. The trick is not spending it on the wrong role.$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRegister
text: I wish I could become friends with more strong people like you!$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro
text: You can make POKéMON stronger or weaker depending on the moves you teach them. / What kinds of moves do your POKéMON know?$

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchDefeat
text: You've taught them good moves!$

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch
text: Maybe I should have stopped my POKéMON from evolving until they learned better moves…$

label: Route111_Text_CeliaIntro
text: I shouldn't have come to a place like this for a picnic!$

label: Route111_Text_CeliaDefeat
text: Aww! I really shouldn't have come!$

label: Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle
text: In a sandstorm like this, I can't set the places for a picnic even with my GO-GOGGLES on…$

label: Route111_Text_BryanIntro
text: How tough are you? We shall expose that secret!$

label: Route111_Text_BryanDefeat
text: Oh! Your strength! It is shrouded in mystery!$

label: Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle
text: This desert hoards mysteries in its shifting sands!$

label: Route111_Text_BrandenIntro
text: I'll give you some of my sandwich if you'll lose.$

label: Route111_Text_BrandenDefeat
text: Tch! I thought a sandwich would be enough of a bribe…$

label: Route111_Text_BrandenPostBattle
text: My whole crew loves sharing my sandwiches.$

label: Route111_Text_TyronIntro
text: This is my favorite kind of POKéMON!$

label: Route111_Text_TyronDefeat
text: Wait! Did you get a good look at my POKéMON?$

label: Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle
text: When having a battle, I get a kick out of showing off my POKéMON. / I bet everyone feels that way when they enter a battle!$

label: Route111_Text_CelinaIntro
text: Show me how to put a little excitement into my life.$

label: Route111_Text_CelinaDefeat
text: Oh… My… That was too much excitement.$

label: Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle
text: My pulse is still racing. You're one fabulous TRAINER.$

label: Route111_Text_HaydenIntro
text: When you're as famished as I am, there is no room for pity!$

label: Route111_Text_HaydenDefeat
text: Groan…$

label: Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle
text: My stomach is grumbling! Maybe I can grill some BERRIES…$

label: Route111_Text_BiancaIntro
text: Did you come from MAUVILLE? Then you should be full of energy!$

label: Route111_Text_BiancaDefeat
text: Ooh lala! That's a lot to take!$

label: Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle
text: This road here… You have quite a ways to travel.$

label: Route112_Text_BriceIntro
text: Hahahaha! How about we have a battle? You and me! Hahahaha!$

label: Route112_Text_BriceDefeat
text: I lost! Hahahaha!$

label: Route112_Text_BricePostBattle
text: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose! Hahahaha-hatchoo!$

label: Route112_Text_TrentIntro
text: My legs are solid from pounding up and down the mountains. / They're not going to buckle easily, friend!$

label: Route112_Text_TrentDefeat
text: Ouch! My legs cramped up!$

label: Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle
text: Try hiking, and I mean really pounding, on these mountain trails with a heavy pack weighing dozens of pounds. / That, my friend, will get your body into serious shape.$

label: Route112_Text_TrentRegister
text: Ow, my legs have cramped up. Can you grab me some bandages from my backpack? / No, that's my POKéNAV! Oh, fine, I'll register you.$

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchIntro
text: I've been keeping fit by hiking. Power, I have in spades!$

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchDefeat
text: I got trumped in power?$

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle
text: I hear there are some seriously tough TRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY. / I intend to get up there and give them a challenge!$

label: Route112_Text_LarryIntro
text: I'm strong. I won't cry if I lose.$

label: Route112_Text_LarryDefeat
text: Waaaah!$

label: Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle
text: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy! Snivel…$

label: Route112_Text_CarolIntro
text: When you're out on a picnic, why, you simply have to sing! Come on, sing with me!$

label: Route112_Text_CarolDefeat
text: Oh, you're so strong!$

label: Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle
text: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad at singing or POKéMON. / If you have the most fun, you win!$

label: Route112_Text_BryantIntro
text: I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH! Take a look!$

label: Route112_Text_BryantDefeat
text: What a bumpy ride that was!$

label: Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle
text: I like the way you battle. It has a certain flair to it.$

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaIntro
text: Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER! Please, I need a romantic battle! I'm somewhat decent!$

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaDefeat
text: Oh, how strong you are! You've given me quite a shock!$

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle
text: That was wonderfully dramatic! I need time to think about every turn. What a romantic battle!$

label: Route113_Text_JaylenIntro
text: Can you guess why it's so cool around here?$

label: Route113_Text_JaylenDefeat
text: Peeuuw! That stinks!$

label: Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle
text: The volcanic ash blocks the sun, so it doesn't get very warm. / That's good for me--I can't stand heat!$

label: Route113_Text_DillonIntro
text: The volcano's eruption is proof that the earth is alive.$

label: Route113_Text_DillonDefeat
text: You're some kind of strong!$

label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
text: Ouch! Owww! I can't see! I got ashes in my eyelashes! / Get it? Ashes and eyelashes? / Okay, that was bad, sorry…$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineIntro
text: I use this parasol to ward off this filthy, yucky volcanic ash from my dear VANILLISH.$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineDefeat
text: Huff, huff… I am exhausted…$

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle
text: You're very good at this. I must say I'm impressed!$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRegister
text: Here, slide under my parasol. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
text: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while? May I invite you to battle?$

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchDefeat
text: Oh, how super!$

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch
text: You've remained very good at this. I must say I'm impressed!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoIntro
text: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoDefeat
text: With honor I admit defeat!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle
text: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.$

label: Route113_Text_LaoRegister
text: Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja technique of POKéNAV registration!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchIntro
text: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchDefeat
text: With honor I admit defeat!$

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch
text: My flawless concealment was let down by my immature battle skills… / I bid thee farewell.$

label: Route113_Text_LungIntro
text: Thanks for finding me! But we still have to battle!$

label: Route113_Text_LungDefeat
text: I'll use my ninjutsu on you… “VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”! / …What? It's already over?$

label: Route113_Text_LungPostBattle
text: You know what's crummy about hiding? It's lonely if no one comes along.$

label: Route113_Text_ToriIntro
text: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes. We battle POKéMON, too.$

label: Route113_Text_ToriDefeat
text: TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going to get some more ashes.$

label: Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle
text: TORI: How much ash do we have? Enough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.$

label: Route113_Text_ToriNotEnoughMons
text: TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2. If we didn't, we would lose!$

label: Route113_Text_TiaIntro
text: TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes. We battle POKéMON, too.$

label: Route113_Text_TiaDefeat
text: TIA: We couldn't win… It's boring, so I'm getting some more ashes.$

label: Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle
text: TIA: We have a lot of ashes! I think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!$

label: Route113_Text_TiaNotEnoughMons
text: TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2. If we don't, we won't win!$

label: Route113_Text_CobyIntro
text: Pfft, with these wings I can flick you away!$

label: Route113_Text_CobyDefeat
text: A… What?$

label: Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle
text: I don't know what to say when I get beaten so easily…$

label: Route113_Text_SophieIntro
text: The warmth here is making me drowsy. Battle with me so I can stay awake.$

label: Route113_Text_SophieDefeat
text: This is a dream. I'm sure of it…$

label: Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle
text: Losing burns me up… I'm just going to sleep right here! Zzz!$

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceIntro
text: Were you maybe in the middle of gathering volcanic ashes?$

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceDefeat
text: Ehehe. We got beaten cleanly.$

label: Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle
text: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.$

label: Route113_Text_WyattIntro
text: Y-you want to battle with me? Even though I just caught my POKéMON?$

label: Route113_Text_WyattDefeat
text: Y-you're all happy to win? Even though it's only me?$

label: Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle
text: Oh, so now you want to say a word to the loser? / Aren't you just the coolest? Humph!$

label: Route114_Text_LennyIntro
text: Yodelayhihoo! / … … / You're supposed to shout “yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't echo here!$

label: Route114_Text_LennyDefeat
text: Yodelayhihoo!$

label: Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle
text: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there was someone copying me and shouting back, “Yodelayhihoo.”$

label: Route114_Text_LucasIntro
text: If you're not prepared, you shouldn't be up in the mountains!$

label: Route114_Text_LucasDefeat
text: The mountains are unforgiving…$

label: Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle
text: In the winter, mountains turn deadly with blizzards and avalanches.$

label: Route114_Text_ShaneIntro
text: Camping's fun! You can fish, roast marshmallows, and tell spooky stories! / But the best of all are the POKéMON battles!$

label: Route114_Text_ShaneDefeat
text: Way too strong!$

label: Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle
text: I think it's great that I can go camping with my POKéMON.$

label: Route114_Text_NancyIntro
text: I need to exercise after a meal. Let's have a match!$

label: Route114_Text_NancyDefeat
text: Oh, no!$

label: Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle
text: I just had a tasty meal. I'm getting drowsy…$

label: Route114_Text_SteveIntro
text: Ufufufufufu… Want to battle against my POKéMON?$

label: Route114_Text_SteveDefeat
text: M-My POKéMON…$

label: Route114_Text_StevePostBattle
text: A big body that's all lumpy and hard, enormous horns, and vicious fangs… / Ufufufufu… I wish I had a POKéMON like that…$

label: Route114_Text_SteveRegister
text: Don't forget what you've done to me! I'll make it so you can't forget!$

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchIntro
text: Ufufufufufu… Come on, battle my POKéMON…$

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchDefeat
text: I feel so lucky getting to see your POKéMON…$

label: Route114_Text_StevePostRematch
text: Ufufufufufu… / When I see POKéMON battling, I get all shivery and shaky…$

label: Route114_Text_BernieIntro
text: If you're lighting a campfire, make sure you have water handy.$

label: Route114_Text_BernieDefeat
text: Thanks for dousing my fire!$

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle
text: You really do have to be careful with any sort of fire in a forest. / Don't ever underestimate the power of fire.$

label: Route114_Text_BernieRegister
text: You set my spirit on fire. Let's register each other!$

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchIntro
text: Have you learned to keep water handy for campfires?$

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchDefeat
text: I got hosed down before I could flare up, I guess.$

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch
text: You really do have to be careful with any sort of fire in a forest. / Don't ever underestimate the power of fire.$

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeIntro
text: If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand a chance against me. So, bring on your POKéMON!$

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeDefeat
text: If we were fishing, I would've won…$

label: Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle
text: I think I'll try my luck at landing a big one at METEOR FALLS. / There has to be something in there. I just know it.$

label: Route114_Text_NolanIntro
text: I like to fish. But I also like to battle! / If anyone challenges me, I'm there, even if I'm fishing.$

label: Route114_Text_NolanDefeat
text: I like to battle, but that doesn't mean I'm good at it…$

label: Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle
text: This time I'll do it! / I always think that, so I can't walk away from fishing or POKéMON.$

label: Route114_Text_TyraIntro
text: TYRA: Well, sure. I'm in the mood for it. I'll teach you a little about POKéMON.$

label: Route114_Text_TyraDefeat
text: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!$

label: Route114_Text_TyraPostBattle
text: TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY about POKéMON.$

label: Route114_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
text: TYRA: Giggle… If you want to battle with us, just one POKéMON isn't enough!$

label: Route114_Text_IvyIntro
text: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?$

label: Route114_Text_IvyDefeat
text: IVY: What an amazing battle style!$

label: Route114_Text_IvyPostBattle
text: IVY: I started training POKéMON because TYRA, my student mentor, taught me!$

label: Route114_Text_IvyNotEnoughMons
text: IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON? I think it must feel lonesome.$

label: Route114_Text_KaiIntro
text: I landed a big one! A huge one, I tell you!$

label: Route114_Text_KaiDefeat
text: What was that about? Did mine lose in size?$

label: Route114_Text_KaiPostBattle
text: Okay! I'll just fish me a bigger one!$

label: Route114_Text_CharlotteIntro
text: Me! I'm not just a pretty face!$

label: Route114_Text_CharlotteDefeat
text: That wasn't cute in the least!$

label: Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle
text: I don't want a POKéMON that's just cute. / I adore cute ones that have a quirk or two!$

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaIntro
text: Have you made your POKéMON evolve very much?$

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaDefeat
text: Oh, I see. That's good to know.$

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaPostBattle
text: Some POKéMON change so much when they evolve, it's startling!$

label: Route115_Text_TimothyIntro
text: HARIYAMA opens with FAKE OUT. Then DUSCLOPS slows the clock for CONKELDURR. / Read the tempo. Then keep me company.$

label: Route115_Text_TimothyDefeat
text: You saw the clock turn before I did.$

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostBattle
text: Effort beats talent, but knowing which turn matters beats effort.$

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRegister
text: Hmm… A loss this thorough has been a distant memory. / If you would allow it, I wish to exchange training observations.$

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchIntro
text: Hm… As always, your agility speaks for itself. Come, keep me company!$

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchDefeat
text: As strong as ever!$

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch
text: All it takes is effort! / I lost because I haven't put in enough effort!$

label: Route115_Text_KoichiIntro
text: You! / My fighting crew! / We demand a battle!$

label: Route115_Text_KoichiDefeat
text: Ouch, ouch, ouch!$

label: Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle
text: My fighting crew! / So long as they seek power, I will grow strong with them!$

label: Route115_Text_NobIntro
text: My strongest skill is busting bricks with my forehead!$

label: Route115_Text_NobDefeat
text: Ugwaaaah! My head is busted!$

label: Route115_Text_NobPostBattle
text: I've been teaching my POKéMON karate. / It looks like they'll get a lot better than me. I'm excited about that.$

label: Route115_Text_NobRegister
text: You impress me! Let me share how our training develops!$

label: Route115_Text_NobRematchIntro
text: After you beat me, we trained hard to improve our skills. Come on, give us a rematch!$

label: Route115_Text_NobRematchDefeat
text: Ugwaaah! We lost again!$

label: Route115_Text_NobPostRematch
text: My POKéMON will grow stronger! I'll redouble my training!$

label: Route115_Text_CyndyIntro
text: This beach is my secret training spot! Don't come butting in!$

label: Route115_Text_CyndyDefeat
text: I haven't trained enough!$

label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostBattle
text: The sand acts as a cushion to reduce impact and prevent injury. This is the perfect place to train.$

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRegister
text: Okay, fine, you're free to come here. In return, share your training tips.$

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchIntro
text: Okay, let's get this battle on!$

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchDefeat
text: I can battle but my POKéMON…$

label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostRematch
text: Even when I lose, I still get some enjoyment out of it. It must be that I love POKéMON.$

label: Route115_Text_HectorIntro
text: I have a rare POKéMON! Would you like me to show you?$

label: Route115_Text_HectorDefeat
text: You… You want my POKéMON, don't you?$

label: Route115_Text_HectorPostBattle
text: I have this rare POKéMON. It's enough to keep me satisfied.$

label: Route115_Text_KyraIntro
text: I'll battle while I'm running! Try to keep up with me!$

label: Route115_Text_KyraDefeat
text: Gasp, gasp…$

label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
text: I made the mistake of trying to battle while running! / I should take a run to calm down…$

label: Route115_Text_JaidenIntro
text: Take that! Ultra POKéMON ninja attack!$

label: Route115_Text_JaidenDefeat
text: Waaah! Our strategy failed!$

label: Route115_Text_JaidenPostBattle
text: But my POKéMON were ultra, weren't they?$

label: Route115_Text_HeleneIntro
text: My POKéMON have black belt-level strength!$

label: Route115_Text_HeleneDefeat
text: This is too humiliating!$

label: Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle
text: I rarely meet anyone who's better than me… / I get it now! You're a GYM LEADER, aren't you?$

label: Route115_Text_AlixIntro
text: Our eyes met! There's no getting away now!$

label: Route115_Text_AlixDefeat
text: Gah! Not bad!$

label: Route115_Text_AlixPostBattle
text: Oh, well. I think I will TELEPORT home.$

label: Route115_Text_MarleneIntro
text: You've disturbed my meditation… You'll be punished for it.$

label: Route115_Text_MarleneDefeat
text: You've broken my concentration!$

label: Route115_Text_MarlenePostBattle
text: I was meditating with my POKéMON. But this place isn't very peaceful…$

label: Route116_Text_ClarkIntro
text: If the tunnel doesn't go through, then I'll just go over the top.$

label: Route116_Text_ClarkDefeat
text: Gasp… Gasp… Losing made me tired…$

label: Route116_Text_ClarkPostBattle
text: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel. To a HIKER, mountains are roads!$

label: Route116_Text_JoeyIntro
text: My POKéMON rule! Check them out!$

label: Route116_Text_JoeyDefeat
text: Ouch! A scrape! I have to put on a bandage!$

label: Route116_Text_JoeyPostBattle
text: Bandages are signs of toughness! I've got another one!$

label: Route116_Text_JoseIntro
text: My BUG POKéMON are tough! Let's battle!$

label: Route116_Text_JoseDefeat
text: I lost! I thought I had you!$

label: Route116_Text_JosePostBattle
text: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly. So they get strong quickly, too.$

label: Route116_Text_JaniceIntro
text: Let me teach you how strong my adorable POKéMON is!$

label: Route116_Text_JaniceDefeat
text: You're a notch above me…$

label: Route116_Text_JanicePostBattle
text: POKéMON that possess cuteness and power, that's ideal, I think.$

label: Route116_Text_JerryIntro
text: We learn all sorts of things at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. / I want to test things out for real!$

label: Route116_Text_JerryDefeat
text: I slacked off in school… That's why I lost.$

label: Route116_Text_JerryPostBattle
text: I'll have to redo some courses at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.$

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister1
text: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS. / I don't really get what that means, so can I just try it?$

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister2
text: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS. / I don't really get what that means, so can I just try it?$

label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchIntro
text: I've been studying seriously at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. I won't lose like I did last time.$

label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchDefeat
text: Hunh? I studied diligently.$

label: Route116_Text_JerryPostRematch
text: I'll have to redo some courses at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.$

label: Route116_Text_KarenIntro
text: I study at school, and I study on the way home, too!$

label: Route116_Text_KarenDefeat
text: I'm in shock--I lost?$

label: Route116_Text_KarenPostBattle
text: Awww, I'll never become an elegant TRAINER like ROXANNE this way!$

label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister1
text: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV? I have one, too! Please register me!$

label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister2
text: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV? I have one, too! Please register me!$

label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchIntro
text: I studied a whole lot since I saw you. You must see my achievements!$

label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchDefeat
text: I'm in shock. I lost again?$

label: Route116_Text_KarenPostRematch
text: You've beaten ROXANNE? I can't beat you, then. Not yet.$

label: Route116_Text_SarahIntro
text: Just so you know, I've never once been bested by anyone at anything.$

label: Route116_Text_SarahDefeat
text: Oh, my goodness. This is a new experience for me.$

label: Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle
text: My life of luxury affords me all that I could possibly desire. / However, when it comes to POKéMON, my wealth has no meaning.$

label: Route116_Text_DawsonIntro
text: When you lay your eyes on my POKéMON's gorgeous fur, their beauty will render you helpless!$

label: Route116_Text_DawsonDefeat
text: Oh, baby, say it isn't so!$

label: Route116_Text_DawsonPostBattle
text: Oh, no, no, no! You've mussed up my POKéMON's fur! You've ruined my hairdo, too! I'll have to call my stylist now!$

label: Route116_Text_DevanIntro
text: We'll rock you hard!$

label: Route116_Text_DevanDefeat
text: Aiyiyi! No contest at all!$

label: Route116_Text_DevanPostBattle
text: I should try different POKéMON types, that's what I ought to do.$

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonIntro
text: It's a dead end up here. I'm bored, so can we battle?$

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonDefeat
text: That was fun even though I lost.$

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonPostBattle
text: Want to stay here and keep me company?$

label: Route117_Text_IsaacIntro
text: Listen, could I get you to battle the POKéMON I'm raising?$

label: Route117_Text_IsaacDefeat
text: You've raised yours superbly…$

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle
text: POKéMON isn't all about power. / Polishing a unique aspect of one's character is another way of enjoying POKéMON.$

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRegister
text: I'm going to redouble my training. Would you come look in on us?$

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
text: The POKéMON I've been raising are looking good, just like before.$

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchDefeat
text: You know how to raise them properly. You might have DAY CARE skills…$

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostRematch
text: Your POKéMON are growing good! You should enter them in CONTESTS.$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaIntro
text: Please, allow me to evaluate if you have raised your POKéMON properly.$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaDefeat
text: Yes, they are growing properly.$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostBattle
text: Try raising POKéMON with more attention to their character traits.$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRegister
text: I'm glad I met a superb TRAINER in you. I hope to see you again.$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchIntro
text: Allow me to reevaluate if you have raised your POKéMON properly.$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchDefeat
text: They are growing admirably.$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch
text: POKéMON seem to like different kinds of {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.$

label: Route117_Text_DylanIntro
text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but, whatever, let's have a battle!$

label: Route117_Text_DylanDefeat
text: I ran out of energy!$

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle
text: I may have blown it… / I might have dropped to last during that battle…$

label: Route117_Text_DylanRegister
text: POKéMON have to be strong, too? I'd like you to train me!$

label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchIntro
text: I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon, but I'm comfortably ahead. Let's make this a quick battle!$

label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchDefeat
text: I ran out of energy again!$

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostRematch
text: I was tops in swimming and cycling, but I'm not quite that confident with POKéMON yet.$

label: Route117_Text_MariaIntro
text: I do my triathlon training with POKéMON, so I'm pretty confident about my speed.$

label: Route117_Text_MariaDefeat
text: I need to get more practices in, I guess.$

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle
text: Training is meaningful only if you keep it up regularly. / Okay! I'll resume my training! Tomorrow!$

label: Route117_Text_MariaRegister
text: You appear to be training properly… I'd like to compare our routines!$

label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchIntro
text: Are you keeping up with your training? I sure am! Let me show you the evidence!$

label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchDefeat
text: I need to get more practices in, I guess.$

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostRematch
text: I'll resume training tomorrow. Let's battle again sometime!$

label: Route117_Text_DerekIntro
text: Once a BUG CATCHER! And now a BUG MANIAC! / But my love for POKéMON remains unchanged!$

label: Route117_Text_DerekDefeat
text: My ineptitude also remains unchanged…$

label: Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle
text: All I did was follow my heart, and now they call me a BUG MANIAC… / Still, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON, so it's only natural that they call me a BUG MANIAC.$

label: Route117_Text_AnnaIntro
text: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student partner. I have to do good!$

label: Route117_Text_AnnaDefeat
text: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student partner! Let me win!$

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle
text: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good combinations. / I'd say you're second only to us!$

label: Route117_Text_AnnaAndMegRegister
text: ANNA: We learned from that loss! Let us share what we discover.$

label: Route117_Text_AnnaNotEnoughMons
text: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring two POKéMON with you.$

label: Route117_Text_MegIntro
text: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super senior student partner and beat you!$

label: Route117_Text_MegDefeat
text: MEG: Oh, no! I'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down…$

label: Route117_Text_MegPostBattle
text: MEG: I dragged ANNA down… If I didn't, she would have won!$

label: Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
text: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON? We can't battle with you, then. / We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.$

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchIntro
text: ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of my junior partner, right?$

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchDefeat
text: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.$

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch
text: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good combinations. / I'd say you're second only to us!$

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchNotEnoughMons
text: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring two POKéMON with you.$

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchIntro
text: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my senior partner and win this time!$

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchDefeat
text: MEG: Too strong!$

label: Route117_Text_MegPostRematch
text: MEG: I battled together with my senior partner, but we lost… / That's so discouraging…$

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons
text: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON? We can't battle with you, then. / We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.$

label: Route117_Text_MelinaIntro
text: Isn't it nice? To battle while looking at pretty flowers?$

label: Route117_Text_MelinaDefeat
text: Oh, that's quite impressive!$

label: Route117_Text_MelinaPostBattle
text: It feels wonderful to go for a jog while looking at flowers.$

label: Route117_Text_BrandiIntro
text: Let me demonstrate the power hidden within a PSYCHIC POKéMON!$

label: Route117_Text_BrandiDefeat
text: Astonishing!$

label: Route117_Text_BrandiPostBattle
text: PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex. You should try catching some.$

label: Route117_Text_AishaIntro
text: Concentrate on getting the win. That's how I battle!$

label: Route117_Text_AishaDefeat
text: I don't waste any time being angry over a loss--I would rather train.$

label: Route117_Text_AishaPostBattle
text: I think that if you worry about losing, you're more likely to lose.$

label: Route118_Text_RoseIntro
text: The aroma of flowers has a magical power. It cleanses us body and soul.$

label: Route118_Text_RoseDefeat
text: Oh, dear me. I seem to have lost.$

label: Route118_Text_RosePostBattle
text: Flowers, POKéMON… I love whatever smells nice. / Stinky things… I'll pass.$

label: Route118_Text_RoseRegister
text: Sniff… That odor--it's a POKéNAV! We must register each other!$

label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchIntro
text: Were you drawn here by the sweet aroma?$

label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchDefeat
text: The power of aroma… It didn't seem to do much.$

label: Route118_Text_RosePostRematch
text: If you use a sweet aroma properly, POKéMON will be attracted by it.$

label: Route118_Text_PerryIntro
text: BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in the sky… They're the best!$

label: Route118_Text_PerryDefeat
text: Urgh… I crashed…$

label: Route118_Text_PerryPostBattle
text: You've got great POKéMON. I'll have to train mine better.$

label: Route118_Text_ChesterIntro
text: Take your marks! My whole team!$

label: Route118_Text_ChesterDefeat
text: They did take flight…$

label: Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle
text: If my birds get stronger, they'll be able to fly more freely…$

label: Route118_Text_BarnyIntro
text: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER. I'm raising the POKéMON I caught.$

label: Route118_Text_BarnyDefeat
text: I thought I was doing okay in my training…$

label: Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle
text: I couldn't win by training POKéMON while I fished… / Was I doing things in half measures?$

label: Route118_Text_WadeIntro
text: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key. / But for TRAINERS, the key ingredients are POKéMON and heart, of course!$

label: Route118_Text_WadeDefeat
text: I was beaten in heart?$

label: Route118_Text_WadePostBattle
text: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle between a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonIntro
text: Let my melody rock your soul!$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonDefeat
text: La-lalala…$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle
text: An electric guitar doesn't always have to be noisy… / It can be strummed to squeeze out this heart-stirring melody…$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRegister
text: When I compose better melodies, you have to come listen, okay?$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchIntro
text: A melody from my POKéMON and me… Let us deliver it to your soul.$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchDefeat
text: La-lalala…$

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch
text: When I play, my emotions should reach you through my electric guitar…$

label: Route118_Text_DeandreIntro
text: Go, go, go! POKéMON 1, 2, and 3!$

label: Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat
text: Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay? POKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!$

label: Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle
text: Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON battle team? / You can copy me--I don't mind!$

label: Route119_Text_BrentIntro
text: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE! We MIMIC what you do!$

label: Route119_Text_BrentDefeat
text: Whoopsie! I lost!$

label: Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle
text: What's so good about mimicry? / Fufufu… You'll never understand…$

label: Route119_Text_DonaldIntro
text: My swarm redirects attacks, spreads sleep, and steals the route's tempo. / Try to keep your plan through all three.$

label: Route119_Text_DonaldDefeat
text: You found the target behind the swarm…$

label: Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle
text: Redirection buys time; it does not decide what to do with that time. You did.$

label: Route119_Text_TaylorIntro
text: If you step forward, we step forward. / If you turn right, we turn, too…$

label: Route119_Text_TaylorDefeat
text: But if you win, I lose…$

label: Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle
text: I can't MIMIC you winning the match. That's just impossible… It's burning me up…$

label: Route119_Text_DougIntro
text: Yep, you've finally caught me! Or were you trying to avoid me?$

label: Route119_Text_DougDefeat
text: Whoop, that was a great match!$

label: Route119_Text_DougPostBattle
text: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE! I hope you enjoyed our performance.$

label: Route119_Text_GregIntro
text: First I copy your pace with TAILWIND. Then my screens copy your defenses. / Show me the move I cannot mimic.$

label: Route119_Text_GregDefeat
text: You attacked around every reflection…$

label: Route119_Text_GregPostBattle
text: Screens soften power, not judgment. Your choices stayed sharper than mine.$

label: Route119_Text_KentIntro
text: One shell accelerates. One empty shell refuses almost every attack. / Read which threat is real before the forest catches fire.$

label: Route119_Text_KentDefeat
text: You identified the real threat…$

label: Route119_Text_KentPostBattle
text: A strange gimmick is only dangerous once if the opponent learns its question.$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
text: A RANGER reads the ground. Here the ground is TAPU KOKO's own terrain.$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonDefeat
text: You read the rain faster than I did.$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle
text: Weather is terrain you can't see. Learn to walk on it.$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRegister
text: I hope you'll share advice without mocking my lack of knowledge.$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
text: I'm going to regain my wild spirit by being together with POKéMON.$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchDefeat
text: You've remained strong!$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch
text: Believe in your POKéMON. Believe in yourself. / The road will reveal itself to you.$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineIntro
text: Traveling light? CASTFORM changes with every storm. GOODRA drinks it. / Let's see how light you really are.$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineDefeat
text: Prepared for everything, then.$

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle
text: You carry exactly what you need and nothing you don't. That's the job.$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRegister
text: Do you have a POKéNAV? It's a must-have tool for any TRAINER. / Oh, you do have one! Let's register each other, then!$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchIntro
text: How's your journey with POKéMON going?$

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchDefeat
text: I'm still missing something…$

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch
text: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER, rely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON rely on you.$

label: Route119_Text_HughIntro
text: The vast sky holds untold promise! / Nothing can compare to the sheer exhilaration of flight!$

label: Route119_Text_HughDefeat
text: Down and out!$

label: Route119_Text_HughPostBattle
text: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of flying come true!$

label: Route119_Text_PhilIntro
