text: I'll show you the true potential of me and my whole team!$

label: Route119_Text_PhilDefeat
text: We lacked potential…$

label: Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle
text: Ever since I was a little kid, I always admired BIRD POKéMON…$

label: Route119_Text_YasuIntro
text: One shadow changes type. One erases boosts. One turns precision into power. / A ninja survives by changing roles.$

label: Route119_Text_YasuDefeat
text: You saw every role before it changed…$

label: Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle
text: Flexibility is not randomness. Each form must answer a specific threat.$

label: Route119_Text_TakashiIntro
text: Levitate keeps my own plan clear. Then sand turns the route against you. / Can your footing survive the shift?$

label: Route119_Text_TakashiDefeat
text: You found solid ground before I did…$

label: Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle
text: Sand rewards a plan with safe footing. Yours had more than one.$

label: Route119_Text_HideoIntro
text: To hide a tree, use a forest!$

label: Route119_Text_HideoDefeat
text: I bow to your superiority.$

label: Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle
text: To hide a tree, use a forest! To hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON! / There is no deep, hidden meaning to that.$

label: Route119_Text_ChrisIntro
text: You spoke to me… So you want to challenge me! / Sure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught while SURFING!$

label: Route119_Text_ChrisDefeat
text: I don't have a clue about what it takes to win.$

label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
text: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON… / Then fish off its back… / It's an indescribably luxuriant moment!$

label: Route119_Text_FabianIntro
text: My rhythm is thunder, voice, and wind. LIGHTNING ROD keeps the band in tune. / Try to break the chorus.$

label: Route119_Text_FabianDefeat
text: You cut the power before the last chord!$

label: Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle
text: A doubles team is a band: each part can solo, but the arrangement wins.$

label: Route119_Text_DaytonIntro
text: Hohoho! I like kid TRAINERS! Let's have a good one!$

label: Route119_Text_DaytonDefeat
text: You're pretty amazing! Hohoho!$

label: Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle
text: Hohoho! I'll try emulating the pep of kid TRAINERS like you!$

label: Route119_Text_RachelIntro
text: My parasol is for more than rain. This whole team changes with weather. / Choose the forecast you can survive.$

label: Route119_Text_RachelDefeat
text: You made my own forecast unsafe…$

label: Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle
text: Weather should create options, not force one script. Your team found another.$

label: Route120_Text_ColinIntro
text: Do you have any moves that can strike a flying POKéMON?$

label: Route120_Text_ColinDefeat
text: You soared above me!$

label: Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle
text: The move FLY is convenient, don't you think? / While the POKéMON is flying, almost no moves can strike it.$

label: Route120_Text_RobertIntro
text: My POKéMON is strong! How about yours?$

label: Route120_Text_RobertDefeat
text: Your POKéMON were stronger…$

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle
text: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one you can count on.$

label: Route120_Text_RobertRegister
text: You can be counted on to get better. I'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!$

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchIntro
text: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one you can count on.$

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchDefeat
text: Your POKéMON are seriously strong.$

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch
text: My POKéMON are growing stronger. I have to grow stronger, too.$

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro
text: Fitness check! OGERPON sets the pace, STARMIE keeps it. Can you keep up?$

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoDefeat
text: You outpaced my whole team!$

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle
text: A RANGER's partners have to move all day. Yours can. Good.$

label: Route120_Text_JennaIntro
text: SHIFTRY and SEVIPER don't wait for you to get ready. Neither do I.$

label: Route120_Text_JennaDefeat
text: I'm fit. You're fitter.$

label: Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle
text: I run with my POKéMON every morning. Try it. Speed is a habit.$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyIntro
text: … … … … … … … … … … … … Want to battle?$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyDefeat
text: Lost it…$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostBattle
text: … … … … … … … … … … … … I'll try harder…$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRegister
text: … … … … … … … … … … … … Do you have a POKéNAV…?$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchIntro
text: … … … … … … … … … … … … Want to battle again?$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchDefeat
text: … … … … … … I lost again…$

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch
text: … … … … … … … … … … … … I'll try harder… For my precious BUG POKéMON…$

label: Route120_Text_JenniferIntro
text: Abilities decide more than moves. PRANKSTER, SHADOW TAG, BAD DREAMS… / If you don't know all three, you'll learn them the hard way.$

label: Route120_Text_JenniferDefeat
text: You knew every one of them.$

label: Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle
text: Read an Ability before the first turn. It changes what “safe” means.$

label: Route120_Text_ChipIntro
text: Who might you be? / Are you perhaps searching for ancient ruins that are rumored to possibly exist according to legend?$

label: Route120_Text_ChipDefeat
text: What a disgraceful setback…$

label: Route120_Text_ChipPostBattle
text: That giant rock… I would like to believe it may indeed contain ancient ruins. But I see no entrance.$

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro
text: My parasol follows the forecast. / Can your team do the same?$

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaDefeat
text: You found shelter inside my storm…$

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle
text: Rain should create choices, not force one answer. Your team found several.$

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro
text: Me, POKéMON, and my parasol… / If any one of them is missing, the picture of beauty will be ruined.$

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaDefeat
text: You've completely ruined my beauty…$

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
text: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all. / Why, something like this would only get in your way.$

label: Route120_Text_KeigoIntro
text: I will adopt the movements of POKéMON and create new ninja techniques.$

label: Route120_Text_KeigoDefeat
text: The creation of new ninja techniques is but a distant dream…$

label: Route120_Text_KeigoPostBattle
text: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under a ninja sensei.$

label: Route120_Text_RileyIntro
text: We ninja conceal ourselves under our camouflage cloaks. I bet you didn't know where I was!$

label: Route120_Text_RileyDefeat
text: I lost! I should camouflage my shame!$

label: Route120_Text_RileyPostBattle
text: Our camouflage cloaks are all handmade.$

label: Route120_Text_CallieIntro
text: If you don't pay attention, you could get hurt!$

label: Route120_Text_CallieDefeat
text: Ouch! I was the one to get hurt.$

label: Route120_Text_CalliePostBattle
text: I wonder… Should I evolve my POKéMON? They're cute the way they are, though.$

label: Route120_Text_LeonelIntro
text: The rain wakes old stories here. Have you seen the masked POKéMON?$

label: Route120_Text_LeonelDefeat
text: You read every change in the field!$

label: Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle
text: A TRAINER with TROPIUS said the marks in this grass answered their party.$

label: Route121_Text_VanessaIntro
text: Will you play with my delightfully pretty POKéMON?$

label: Route121_Text_VanessaDefeat
text: This isn't what I meant!$

label: Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle
text: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE. / My POKéMON should have no problem sweeping the MASTER CLASS.$

label: Route121_Text_WalterIntro
text: With my POKéMON, I have traveled to the world's four corners. / You might say I have some confidence in my abilities.$

label: Route121_Text_WalterDefeat
text: Ah, well played.$

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostBattle
text: I would like to circle the globe once again with my POKéMON.$

label: Route121_Text_WalterRegister
text: Your POKéMON prowess is remarkable. Allow me to register you as a memento.$

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro
text: With my POKéMON, I have traveled to the world's four corners. / You might say I have some confidence in my abilities.$

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchDefeat
text: Ah, well played.$

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch
text: Your POKéMON and you… / Your prowess together will be considered strong, even overseas.$

label: Route121_Text_TammyIntro
text: There are powers beyond our understanding in the world…$

label: Route121_Text_TammyDefeat
text: I have lost…$

label: Route121_Text_TammyPostBattle
text: MT. PYRE… There is a mysterious power at work there…$

label: Route121_Text_KateIntro
text: KATE: Together, we're fearless! We'll demonstrate how tough we are!$

label: Route121_Text_KateDefeat
text: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior student partner…$

label: Route121_Text_KatePostBattle
text: KATE: When someone's relying on me, I get this urge to look cool in front of them…$

label: Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons
text: KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON, we can't battle with you. / That would be bullying.$

label: Route121_Text_JoyIntro
text: JOY: Together, we're fearless! We'll demonstrate how tough we are!$

label: Route121_Text_JoyDefeat
text: JOY: Please forgive me, KATE!$

label: Route121_Text_JoyPostBattle
text: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE, my senior student partner, again.$

label: Route121_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
text: JOY: You need at least two POKéMON if you're going to challenge us!$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaIntro
text: Stop! Have a good look at my precious POKéMON!$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaDefeat
text: Oh, how dare you! Don't take it so seriously!$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostBattle
text: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at the SAFARI.$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRegister
text: I took it easy on you! Still, I learned plenty from that.$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchIntro
text: My precious POKéMON grew! Have a good look!$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchDefeat
text: Oh, how dare you! You still won't take it easy!$

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostRematch
text: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at the SAFARI.$

label: Route121_Text_CristinIntro
text: Five TRAINERS a day, that's my routine. NINETALES sets the sun. You're five.$

label: Route121_Text_CristinDefeat
text: No! You're horrid!$

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostBattle
text: I didn't expect the fifth one to be the hard one. Next time.$

label: Route121_Text_CristinRegister
text: That was total humiliation! I won't forget you… Hand over your POKéNAV!$

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchIntro
text: I have this new routine. Defeat ten TRAINERS a day. Guess what? You're number ten!$

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchDefeat
text: Wait! That's nasty! I demand a rematch!$

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostRematch
text: An opponent I just can't beat… Snivel… I can't believe this is happening…$

label: Route121_Text_CaleIntro
text: Can't you see that I have all this stuff with me? / Despite that, you still insist that we battle?$

label: Route121_Text_CaleDefeat
text: Of course I lost! I'm holding stuff in both hands!$

label: Route121_Text_CalePostBattle
text: I bought too much stuff at the LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE. / It's up the road from here. I wish I had a BAG like yours.$

label: Route121_Text_MylesIntro
text: There's nothing I love more than checking out other people's POKéMON!$

label: Route121_Text_MylesDefeat
text: Super awesome!$

label: Route121_Text_MylesPostBattle
text: They're great, your POKéMON! How do you raise them?$

label: Route121_Text_PatIntro
text: I want everybody to see the POKéMON I've raised!$

label: Route121_Text_PatDefeat
text: Wow! Spectacular!$

label: Route121_Text_PatPostBattle
text: I raise every POKéMON with the same love and care--I don't pick favorites.$

label: Route121_Text_MarcelIntro
text: My gang has never tasted defeat. ZERAORA, show them why!$

label: Route121_Text_MarcelDefeat
text: Oh. Now what happened here?$

label: Route121_Text_MarcelPostBattle
text: Undefeated is a nice word until the first loss. Time to earn it again.$

label: Route123_Text_WendyIntro
text: SCIZOR pulls, HYDREIGON pushes. Want to find out how strong you are? I'm the test.$

label: Route123_Text_WendyDefeat
text: Passed. With room to spare.$

label: Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle
text: You beat me without a single wasted turn. That's the whole exam.$

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro
text: That's a lot of BADGES. Let's see if they survive BRAVIARY and GARCHOMP.$

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonDefeat
text: Worthy. Every one of them.$

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
text: You did those BADGES proud. Now go earn the ones that are left.$

label: Route123_Text_VioletIntro
text: They say that good times are filled with good aromas.$

label: Route123_Text_VioletDefeat
text: Oh… I smell the bitter scent of misery…$

label: Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle
text: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled with uplifting fragrances.$

label: Route123_Text_CameronIntro
text: Being a psychic is about willpower. / I've willed myself not to lose to anyone. That makes me strong!$

label: Route123_Text_CameronDefeat
text: I feel sad…$

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle
text: Being a psychic is about willpower. I thought I wouldn't lose to you…$

label: Route123_Text_CameronRegister
text: I sense it! You and I shall stay connected! I can't tell what I'll sense, though… / Let's see your POKéNAV.$

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchIntro
text: I've convinced myself that I won't lose anymore. That makes me strong!$

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchDefeat
text: I feel sad…$

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch
text: I should train at MT. PYRE… I'll never beat you this way…$

label: Route123_Text_JackiIntro
text: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON develop psychic powers. / You need to refine those powers to make them really useful.$

label: Route123_Text_JackiDefeat
text: Overwhelmed!$

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle
text: We all have psychic powers. We've just forgotten how to use them.$

label: Route123_Text_JackiRegister
text: I would like to study your technique. May I register your contact?$

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchIntro
text: Have you awoken the psychic powers within you?$

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchDefeat
text: Astounding!$

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch
text: Your power with POKéMON… That could be a psychic power, too.$

label: Route123_Text_MiuIntro
text: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your POKéMON won't cry when they lose.$

label: Route123_Text_MiuDefeat
text: MIU: Uh-oh, we lost.$

label: Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle
text: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are strong because you are friends.$

label: Route123_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
text: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you don't have two POKéMON.$

label: Route123_Text_YukiIntro
text: YUKI: Okay! We're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!$

label: Route123_Text_YukiDefeat
text: YUKI: Uh-oh, we lost.$

label: Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle
text: YUKI: Why are you so strong? We've never lost before.$

label: Route123_Text_YukiNotEnoughMons
text: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you don't have two POKéMON.$

label: Route123_Text_KindraIntro
text: MT. PYRE… Where the spirits of POKéMON sleep… Will your POKéMON sleep?$

label: Route123_Text_KindraDefeat
text: Overflowing with vitality…$

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
text: MT. PYRE… Where the spirits of POKéMON sleep… / It must overflow with a power that soothes spirits…$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoIntro
text: I'll turn your lights out while I rip through this tune!$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoDefeat
text: Hey, hold it! I was still playing the intro!$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle
text: You're rock steady. I'd like to write a tune about you.$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRegister
text: The next time, lend your ears to the full tune, will you?$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchIntro
text: Today's the day I'm going to do it! I'll turn out your lights before I finish singing my song!$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchDefeat
text: Hey, hold it! I haven't even hit the chorus!$

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch
text: I thought you'd be so enthralled by my tune, you'd lose.$

label: Route123_Text_DavisIntro
text: This is my awesome BUG POKéMON! My big brother got it for me.$

label: Route123_Text_DavisDefeat
text: Waaaah! You meanie!$

label: Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle
text: Don't tell my brother I lost. You have to keep it a secret!$

label: Route123_Text_JazmynIntro
text: ABSOL sees it coming, LUCARIO punishes it. Beating someone strong is how I keep my confidence up.$

label: Route123_Text_JazmynDefeat
text: There goes my confidence…$

label: Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle
text: You didn't look like much. Looks lie. I should know better by now.$

label: Route123_Text_FrederickIntro
text: Hello, child! Can you spare some time?$

label: Route123_Text_FrederickDefeat
text: Ah, a mighty capable child! Let me contribute to your allowance.$

label: Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle
text: Contribute to your allowance? Wasn't the prize money enough?$

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro
text: I have to tell you, BIRD POKéMON are my obsession! / Birds are cool! They're the best!$

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoDefeat
text: Even in defeat, BIRD POKéMON are cool!$

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle
text: I gather BIRD POKéMON feathers that scatter during battles. / I'm going to make a hat with BIRD POKéMON feathers.$

label: Route123_Text_EdIntro
text: When there are no TRAINERS around, I let my POKéMON battle each other. I watch them.$

label: Route123_Text_EdDefeat
text: I kind of like your POKéMON.$

label: Route123_Text_EdPostBattle
text: Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas! I think they'll make me better.$

label: Route123_Text_JonasIntro
text: I lay in ambush, and a TRAINER has landed in my trap!$

label: Route123_Text_JonasDefeat
text: If you don't lose, how am I supposed to have fun playing ninja?$

label: Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle
text: I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking TRAINER next time.$

label: Route123_Text_KayleyIntro
text: I just bought this parasol. My cuteness should be up by a third!$

label: Route123_Text_KayleyDefeat
text: You're better than me by about five times!$

label: Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle
text: Using accessories effectively is the secret behind fashion appeal.$

label: Route124_Text_SpencerIntro
text: Hey, are you lost at sea? / If you can beat my POKéMON, I can serve as your pilot.$

label: Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat
text: I lost my bearings in battle!$

label: Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle
text: Many people lose their bearings at sea. / If you're that sort, you should refer to the POKéNAV's MAP.$

label: Route124_Text_RolandIntro
text: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead of swimming yourself… / I am envious!$

label: Route124_Text_RolandDefeat
text: Oh! I can't…$

label: Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle
text: I'm getting chilled… I've been in the water too long… / I wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…$

label: Route124_Text_JennyIntro
text: If you just float in the sea like this, POKéMON come around to play.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyDefeat
text: Oh, darn. I've gone and lost.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle
text: While swimming, I noticed that some POKéMON attack, and some just watch. / I guess POKéMON have personalities of their own.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyRegister
text: It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get you to register me in your POKéNAV.$

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchIntro
text: If you just float in the sea like this, TRAINERS challenge you!$

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchDefeat
text: That's strange… I lost again…$

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch
text: This has nothing to do with anything, but maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.$

label: Route124_Text_GraceIntro
text: I'm growing bored of swimming… How about a battle?$

label: Route124_Text_GraceDefeat
text: I had no idea that you were this strong!$

label: Route124_Text_GracePostBattle
text: All the effort you put in must have made you this strong.$

label: Route124_Text_ChadIntro
text: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater to go deep under cover. Plumbing the depths is where I excel!$

label: Route124_Text_ChadDefeat
text: Glub, glub, glub… I'm sinking…$

label: Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle
text: I have it on good authority that there's a DIVE spot around here. / It gives me the urge to go deep again…$

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
text: LILA: Sigh… / Here I am in the sea, but who's with me? My little brother! / Let's battle so I won't have to dwell on that!$

label: Route124_Text_LilaDefeat
text: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost! You're in for it later!$

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle
text: LILA: Sigh… / If only it wasn't my little brother next to me, but a nice boyfriend…$

label: Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons
text: LILA: You're planning to battle us? Not unless you have two POKéMON.$

label: Route124_Text_RoyIntro
text: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON! / Don't cry when you lose!$

label: Route124_Text_RoyDefeat
text: ROY: Uh-oh… My big sister will chew me out…$

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle
text: ROY: My big sister is really scary when she gets angry. / That's why she doesn't have a boyfriend.$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister
text: ROY: Can we trade training tips? LILA keeps working me too hard!$

label: Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons
text: ROY: Did you want to battle us? Bring two POKéMON, then.$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
text: LILA: Sigh… / Here I am in the sea, but who's with me? My little brother! / Oh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle so I won't have to dwell on things!$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat
text: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost again! / We're having a training session later!$

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch
text: LILA: Sigh… / If I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat anyone with lovely combinations…$

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchNotEnoughMons
text: LILA: You're planning to battle us? Not unless you have two POKéMON.$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro
text: ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck. I'm going to go totally all out!$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchDefeat
text: ROY: Uh-oh… My big sister will chew me out again.$

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch
text: ROY: My big sister is really scary when she gets angry. / She's going to make me train really hard with POKéMON later…$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchNotEnoughMons
text: ROY: Did you want to battle us? Bring two POKéMON, then.$

label: Route124_Text_DeclanIntro
text: Here I am swimming by my lonesome on this wide, beautiful sea. / There's no other word for it. This is pathetic!$

label: Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat
text: I'm feeling blue. Blue as the sky…$

label: Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle
text: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS and invite them on a long swim.$

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro
text: I'm not going to lose to some surfer TRAINER.$

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat
text: I've only got sweat in my eyes! I am not crying!$

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle
text: You can find pretty colored shards of things around here.$

label: Route125_Text_NolenIntro
text: I heard you approaching, so I hung around for you!$

label: Route125_Text_NolenDefeat
text: I surrender!$

label: Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle
text: Sound travels faster in water than it does through air.$

label: Route125_Text_StanIntro
text: Hey, there! Check out my sweet POKéMON!$

label: Route125_Text_StanDefeat
text: I floundered…$

label: Route125_Text_StanPostBattle
text: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm, so I started swimming, too.$

label: Route125_Text_TanyaIntro
text: I'm tired of swimming. Are you up for a battle with me?$

label: Route125_Text_TanyaDefeat
text: You're too much!$

label: Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle
text: Whew… Which way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?$

label: Route125_Text_SharonIntro
text: How would you like to take on the WATER-type POKéMON I raised?$

label: Route125_Text_SharonDefeat
text: Lost it…$

label: Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle
text: Your power… You're the real deal. I'm amazed!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestIntro
text: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR! I've braved the world's seas!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestDefeat
text: Gwrroooar! I couldn't win!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle
text: The tide ebbs and flows inside the SHOAL CAVE. / By the way, it's about six hours from high tide to low tide. Did you know?$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRegister
text: Register me in your POKéNAV, and I'll tell you something good.$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
text: It's high time I get my payback from you! Come on, we're battling!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchDefeat
text: I couldn't win! I flat out couldn't win!$

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
text: The SHOAL CAVE… / There are places you can and can't get to depending on the rise and fall of the tide. / By the way, it's about six hours from high tide to low tide. Don't forget!$

label: Route125_Text_KimIntro
text: KIM: A funny old man lives in the SHOAL CAVE. Someone told me. Are you going to see him, too?$

label: Route125_Text_KimDefeat
text: KIM: I thought we would win.$

label: Route125_Text_KimPostBattle
text: KIM: A funny old man lives in the SHOAL CAVE, doesn't he? / Let's go see him, IRIS!$

label: Route125_Text_KimNotEnoughMons
text: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON, or it's just no good!$

label: Route125_Text_IrisIntro
text: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're looking for out here?$

label: Route125_Text_IrisDefeat
text: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.$

label: Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle
text: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into the SHOAL CAVE? We'll get all wet.$

label: Route125_Text_IrisNotEnoughMons
text: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do anything like a 2-on-1 battle.$

label: Route125_Text_PresleyIntro
text: Why would a BIRDKEEPER like me come out to the sea?$

label: Route125_Text_PresleyDefeat
text: Okay. I'll tell you why I'm here.$

label: Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle
text: I put a message in a bottle and put it out to sea. / I'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will find it!$

label: Route125_Text_AuronIntro
text: Hey! Was it you dumping trash in the sea? Doesn't matter. LUCARIO wants a fight either way.$

label: Route125_Text_AuronDefeat
text: Oh. Not you, then. Sorry.$

label: Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle
text: Someone's been polluting these waves. If I find them, they meet VAPOREON.$

label: Route126_Text_BarryIntro
text: Swimming is a full-body workout! You will get fit!$

label: Route126_Text_BarryDefeat
text: I admit it! You win!$

label: Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle
text: Thanks to my daily swimming routine… Look! Feast your eyes on this physique!$

label: Route126_Text_DeanIntro
text: This towering white mountain of rock is SOOTOPOLIS CITY.$

label: Route126_Text_DeanDefeat
text: I was done in?$

label: Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle
text: I can't find the entrance to SOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?$

label: Route126_Text_NikkiIntro
text: Ufufufufu! I'm a mermaid!$

label: Route126_Text_NikkiDefeat
text: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble! Blub, blub, blub…$

label: Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle
text: You thrashed me… I want to disappear in a wave of despair…$

label: Route126_Text_BrendaIntro
text: Hello, kiddo! Want a battle with me?$

label: Route126_Text_BrendaDefeat
text: Oh, noooooh!$

label: Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle
text: I love frolicking with POKéMON in the sea like this!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloIntro
text: Check out this sculpted body! I'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloDefeat
text: Whoops! Too strong! Not bad! Not bad at all!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle
text: Losing to you stimulated my senses! I'll train myself and POKéMON harder!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloRegister
text: Yep, you're not bad at all! I'd like to get to know you more!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchIntro
text: Check out this beautiful body! I'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchDefeat
text: Whoops! Really too strong! Not bad! Not bad at all!$

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch
text: I'm going to train even harder! You're a great motivator! You have to come back again!$

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro
text: I couldn't even swim last year, but now I'm a decent SWIMMER. / I think I'm capable of anything now.$

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoDefeat
text: Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do a thing for me.$

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle
text: If you practice at something, you will get better at it. / You're young--don't be afraid to try all sorts of things!$

label: Route126_Text_IsobelIntro
text: If seawater gets up your nose, doesn't it feel terrible?$

label: Route126_Text_IsobelDefeat
text: Ack! Why, you… Glub!$

label: Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle
text: Ooh, I choked on some water! It's bitter! It's salty!!$

label: Route126_Text_SiennaIntro
text: I'm throwing my whole heart into this!$

label: Route126_Text_SiennaDefeat
text: You had more heart!$

label: Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle
text: I need to cool down now… I think I'll go for a dive.$

label: Route127_Text_CamdenIntro
text: I can see it in your face. You want to challenge me.$

label: Route127_Text_CamdenDefeat
text: Awawawawawa…$

label: Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle
text: A well-played match leaves me feeling refreshed and serene.$

label: Route127_Text_DonnyIntro
text: Do you have a rival whom you just hate to lose against?$

label: Route127_Text_DonnyDefeat
text: Arrrgh! I hate losing!$

label: Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle
text: If you have a rival, don't you get the feeling that you have to keep getting better?$

label: Route127_Text_JonahIntro
text: Through fishing, I have attained a state of becalmed serenity… / Please, allow me to demonstrate…$

label: Route127_Text_JonahDefeat
text: Though I have lost, my heart remains calm…$

label: Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle
text: It matters not that I catch nothing. The line remains in the water…$

label: Route127_Text_HenryIntro
text: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged a SURFING POKéMON?$

label: Route127_Text_HenryDefeat
text: I can't keep up!$

label: Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle
text: It'd be a handful if I hooked your tough POKéMON!$

label: Route127_Text_RogerIntro
text: Well, hey! This is a match between a POKéMON fan and a fishing buff!$

label: Route127_Text_RogerDefeat
text: No! My line's all tangled! The party's over!$

label: Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle
text: My fishing line's doing a dance! The tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!$

label: Route127_Text_AidanIntro
text: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision. They spot prey from great heights.$

label: Route127_Text_AidanDefeat
text: Whew… I give up.$

label: Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle
text: There're lots of diving spots in the sea around here. / You can spot them easily from the sky because of their darker color.$

label: Route127_Text_KojiIntro
text: Run in your bare feet. That will toughen up your soles!$

label: Route127_Text_KojiDefeat
text: Yowch! I got a pebble under a toenail!$

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle
text: Going barefoot feels great. But your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.$

label: Route127_Text_KojiRegister
text: This is what I do to people who beat me! I'll send you my barefoot training tips.$

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchIntro
text: I still run in my bare feet daily. My soles are tough!$

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchDefeat
text: Yowch! Pebbles dug into my arches!$

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch
text: Want to go barefoot for a while? So I can try your RUNNING SHOES?$

label: Route127_Text_AthenaIntro
text: Slow and methodical. Then PHEROMOSA makes it fast. Shall we?$

label: Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat
text: You never let me strategize.$

label: Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle
text: Out here, time slows down. Battles don't. I keep forgetting that.$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahIntro
text: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways away…$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahDefeat
text: My first victory seems to be far away, too…$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
text: My whole life has been about losing, but I will never give up!$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister
text: I know I'm not good now, but I think I can win eventually. / Please register me and track my progress.$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
text: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on swimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchDefeat
text: I've yet to taste my first victory…$

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch
text: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY where I can eventually win…$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynIntro
text: You have to swim, cycle, and then run a marathon in a triathlon. / It's a grueling race that consists of three events.$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynDefeat
text: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too…$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle
text: I have to ride a BIKE next, but… I'm about to throw in the towel…$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRegister
text: Well, I may as well make the best of this. Let's exchange training notes.$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
text: A triathlon is long. But I guess the road to become the POKéMON CHAMPION is also a long and grueling one.$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchDefeat
text: A POKéMON battle really is harsh and unforgiving…$

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch
text: You should give serious thought to challenges on VICTORY ROAD.$

label: Route128_Text_AlexaIntro
text: We've trained for the LEAGUE for a year. FERALIGATR, SCIZOR… we can't lose now!$

label: Route128_Text_AlexaDefeat
text: Oh! How could this happen?!$

label: Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle
text: One setback. I've had a hundred. The LEAGUE is still where I'm going.$

label: Route128_Text_RubenIntro
text: There is no stronger TRAINER than me. DRAGONITE agrees. So does HEATMOR.$

label: Route128_Text_RubenDefeat
text: This can't be!$

label: Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle
text: Correction. There is probably no stronger TRAINER than you. Probably.$

label: Route128_Text_WayneIntro
text: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I caught myself a POKéMON that knows the move WATERFALL to crest the falls.$

label: Route128_Text_WayneDefeat
text: I'm crestfallen!$

label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
text: Awww, phooey! / My POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but I don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!$

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro
text: You're looking awfully tough. I wonder if I can win?$

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat
text: Ouch! I guess it was impossible to win.$

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle
text: There are tough TRAINERS galore around EVER GRANDE. / Do you think I may be out of my league?$

label: Route128_Text_CarleeIntro
text: The sunlight seems to be more harsh in this area.$

label: Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat
text: I couldn't see very well because of the sun's glare.$

label: Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle
text: I should go back soon. I need to reapply my sunscreen.$

label: Route129_Text_ChaseIntro
text: This is my first triathlon. I'm all tense and nervous!$

label: Route129_Text_ChaseDefeat
text: Wroooaaar! I failed to win!$

label: Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle
text: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to give it my all.$

label: Route129_Text_AllisonIntro
text: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but, sure, why don't we battle?$

label: Route129_Text_AllisonDefeat
text: I was sure I'd win!$

label: Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle
text: Do you know what's the greatest thing about triathlons? / Testing the limits of your own strength and endurance against Mother Nature!$

label: Route129_Text_ReedIntro
text: Say hey, hey! Let's get on with it!$

label: Route129_Text_ReedDefeat
text: Beat, I'm beaten. That's it, done!$

label: Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle
text: There's nothing for a loser. Time for me to beat it home.$

label: Route129_Text_TishaIntro
text: What's the hurry? Let's take it slow and easy.$

label: Route129_Text_TishaDefeat
text: Oh, my. I wanted to relax a little more…$

label: Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle
text: Don't you hate making mistakes when you're in a rush? / That's why I try to take things slowly.$

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro
text: Surfing isn't as easy as it seems, isn't that right?$

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceDefeat
text: Winning sure isn't easy.$

label: Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle
text: You have your sights on the POKéMON LEAGUE? Keep at it!$

label: Route130_Text_RodneyIntro
text: What a surprise! I didn't expect to see a TRAINER out in the sea. / I think we should battle!$

label: Route130_Text_RodneyDefeat
text: This kid's awfully tough…$

label: Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle
text: Your eyes have that look of someone who's experienced harsh challenges and won. It suits you well!$

label: Route130_Text_KatieIntro
text: In the deep blue sea, my shattered blue heart finds comfort among waves.$

label: Route130_Text_KatieDefeat
text: Like the vast blue sea, the world of POKéMON spans depths beyond belief.$

label: Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle
text: The world's children dream of one day becoming the POKéMON CHAMPION.$

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro
text: Floating on the open sea like this… It's peaceful.$

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat
text: I needed to be a little less peaceful!$

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle
text: Swimming and battling like this… I'm one happy guy…$

label: Route131_Text_RichardIntro
text: The sea is teeming with POKéMON. It's not easy swimming, I tell you.$

label: Route131_Text_RichardDefeat
text: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are seriously tough…$

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
text: Gasp… Gasp… I'm wiped out… / The going's easy. It's the leaving that's the hard part. / Will I have any energy left to make the return trip?$

label: Route131_Text_HermanIntro
text: The sea… The sea… The sea… The sea as far as these eyes can see! I'm sick and tired of the sea!$

label: Route131_Text_HermanDefeat
text: Bleah!$

label: Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle
text: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must. / I'm a born swimmer! That's what I am.$

label: Route131_Text_SusieIntro
text: Hi, sweetie, wait! We should battle, you and I!$

label: Route131_Text_SusieDefeat
text: You're tough in spite of the way you look!$

label: Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle
text: Did you see a guy over there who whines that he's bored of the sea? / That's all talk. He's hopelessly in love with the sea!$

label: Route131_Text_KaraIntro
text: Why do men love bathing suits so much? / They all ogle me!$

label: Route131_Text_KaraDefeat
text: I'm out of my depth!$

label: Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle
text: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that makes men look. It must be my beauty!$

label: Route131_Text_ReliIntro
text: RELI: We'll work together as siblings to take you on!$

label: Route131_Text_ReliDefeat
text: RELI: We couldn't win even though we worked together…$

label: Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle
text: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are together with the sea and POKéMON from the time they are born.$

label: Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons
text: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON? We can't enjoy a battle, then.$

label: Route131_Text_IanIntro
text: IAN: I'm doing my best together with my sis!$

label: Route131_Text_IanDefeat
text: IAN: I did my best with my sis, but we still couldn't win…$

label: Route131_Text_IanPostBattle
text: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is a floating town? / So, wherever there is the sea, that's a part of PACIFIDLOG!$

label: Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
text: IAN: If you have two POKéMON, we'll take you on!$

label: Route131_Text_TaliaIntro
text: If you can beat me, I'll give you some great information!$

label: Route131_Text_TaliaDefeat
text: Oh? Did I lose?$

label: Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle
text: There is an odd place nearby. There's a huge tower there. Why don't you go take a look?$

label: Route131_Text_KevinIntro
text: The people of PACIFIDLOG are a peaceful bunch. / They never get angry. That goes for me, too.$

label: Route131_Text_KevinDefeat
text: Oops!$

label: Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle
text: Tch! …Oh, wait. I'm not angry. Honestly! / But, boy, you're strong! Hahaha!$

label: Route132_Text_GilbertIntro
text: I used to catch colds all the time as a kid, but I became totally fit after I started swimming.$

label: Route132_Text_GilbertDefeat
text: I crave more power…$

label: Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle
text: TRAINERS travel the fields and mountains, so they must be fit, too.$

label: Route132_Text_DanaIntro
text: I try not to swim where the currents are too strong.$

label: Route132_Text_DanaDefeat
text: Oh, please, no!$

label: Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle
text: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my sense of place…$

label: Route132_Text_RonaldIntro
text: Win or lose, you'll never know until you try!$

label: Route132_Text_RonaldDefeat
text: Waah! I sank in defeat!$

label: Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle
text: I never battle when I know I'll win. I like to battle at the razor's edge of victory and defeat!$

label: Route132_Text_KiyoIntro
text: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day. How could you possibly beat me?$

label: Route132_Text_KiyoDefeat
text: I lose. I will concede defeat.$

label: Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle
text: Urggh… You're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you? / You must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day, don't you?$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro
text: I'm usually with my husband, but my AMOONGUSS and I win fine without him.$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat
text: Oh. I guess not this time.$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
text: That young man looks just like my husband did. Don't tell him I said so.$

label: Route132_Text_JonathanIntro
text: Someone's been watching me. Was it you? RAMPARDOS doesn't like being watched.$

label: Route132_Text_JonathanDefeat
text: Wow! You're strong, all right!$

label: Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle
text: I still feel eyes on me. It's probably the SABLEYE. I keep forgetting it's mine.$

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro
text: My wife's wandered off again. Fine. BRELOOM and I can win on our own.$

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonDefeat
text: I see. Couldn't manage it alone.$

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
text: She'll be looking for me. Her BEARTIC would have handled you, you know.$

label: Route132_Text_DarcyIntro
text: I liked training here alone. Now it's crowded. PORYGON-Z, clear the beach!$

label: Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat
text: Okay. I'll stop complaining.$

label: Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle
text: Maybe I'll team up with that old man and challenge the couple. Doubles.$

label: Route133_Text_FranklinIntro
text: Did the currents carry you here, too? This must have been fated. Let's battle!$

label: Route133_Text_FranklinDefeat
text: Strong! Too much so!$

label: Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle
text: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER like you would drift here… I must be cursed…$

label: Route133_Text_DebraIntro
text: I've led a life of woe and misery… I've been cast away, and this is where I've drifted…$

label: Route133_Text_DebraDefeat
text: Another loss…$

label: Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle
text: A life adrift… I don't want it anymore!$

label: Route133_Text_LindaIntro
text: Welcome! I've been expecting you!$

label: Route133_Text_LindaDefeat
text: No! Please!$

label: Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle
text: A strong child TRAINER… That's so annoying!$

label: Route133_Text_WarrenIntro
text: Everyone raises the same six. Not me. MUSHARNA and TORTERRA, my way.$

label: Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat
text: Darn it! My way is still too slack!$

label: Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle
text: Doing it my own way is more fun than copying. Even when I lose.$

label: Route133_Text_BeckIntro
text: I came all the way out here with my BIRD POKéMON.$

label: Route133_Text_BeckDefeat
text: You… You're stunningly cool!$

label: Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle
text: I'd like to go back to FORTREE, but I've grown to like this place, too.$

label: Route133_Text_MollieIntro
text: I've battled thousands of times. GENGAR remembers every one of them.$

label: Route133_Text_MollieDefeat
text: Thousands of losses, and this one still stings.$

label: Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle
text: Keep at it, youngster. Get old doing this, like my husband and me.$

label: Route133_Text_ConorIntro
text: Young people drift. No direction. FERROTHORN and I don't drift.$

label: Route133_Text_ConorDefeat
text: You have a firm sense of purpose.$

label: Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle
text: Don't let anyone steer you. Not even an old man who just lost to you.$

label: Route134_Text_JackIntro
text: Even those POKéMON that can swim are carried along by the rapid currents.$

label: Route134_Text_JackDefeat
text: Aiyeeeeh!$

label: Route134_Text_JackPostBattle
text: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running currents around these parts.$

label: Route134_Text_LaurelIntro
text: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun match. Will you join us?$

label: Route134_Text_LaurelDefeat
text: Oopsie!$

label: Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle
text: There's a collector who's after the SCALES of LUVDISC.$

label: Route134_Text_AlexIntro
text: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang! It's time for a match!$

label: Route134_Text_AlexDefeat
text: Tuckered out again…$

label: Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle
text: My whole team gets tired quickly after a long journey…$

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro
text: You're a POKéMON TRAINER. No need for words. We battle now.$

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
text: It was I who challenged you, and yet I lost. I am deeply shamed…$

label: Route134_Text_AaronIntro
text: The tide here is savage. It's made my Dragons savage too. TYRANTRUM!$

label: Route134_Text_AaronDefeat
text: I concede. Willingly, even.$

label: Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle
text: We train at METEOR FALLS next. Come along if you want to be toughened.$

label: Route134_Text_KelvinIntro
text: O-our boat! The tide carried it away!$

label: Route134_Text_KelvinDefeat
text: Awawawawah! Please, stop! Please!$

label: Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle
text: If we can't SURF, how are we supposed to get home? / Actually, I know a fainted POKéMON can still SURF, but it feels wrong.$

label: Route134_Text_MarleyIntro
text: Can your team dodge lightning? ARCANINE and ESCAVALIER move before you blink.$

label: Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat
text: I didn't know that technique existed. Thoroughly beaten.$

label: Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle
text: I haven't lost my passion for speed. Just the battle. Speed comes back.$

label: Route134_Text_ReynaIntro
text: My POKéMON can't be taken down easily!$

label: Route134_Text_ReynaDefeat

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
text: A POKéMON CONTEST involves four TRAINERS entering one POKéMON each in competitive judging. / A CONTEST has two stages of judging, primary and secondary. / Primary judging is a popularity poll involving the audience. / Secondary judging features appeals by the POKéMON using their moves. / Plan appeals carefully to earn the most attention of the JUDGE and excite the audience. Do your best to stand out. / The primary and secondary scores are added at the end. / The POKéMON garnering the highest score is declared the winner.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes
text: There are five kinds of CONTESTS. / COOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and TOUGH are the five categories. / Choose the CONTEST that is right for the POKéMON you plan to enter.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
text: There are four ranks of POKéMON CONTESTS. / NORMAL, SUPER, HYPER, and MASTER are the four ranks. / In the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may enter. / Any POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank CONTEST may move up to the SUPER Rank in the same category. / In the same way, a SUPER Rank winner can move up to the HYPER Rank, and a HYPER Rank winner can advance to the MASTER Rank in the same category. / A POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank may compete in the MASTER Rank as often as its TRAINER wants.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
text: This is a CONTEST for two to four players linked using a Wireless Adapter or a GBA Game Link cable. / Participants are first asked to choose the mode they wish to enter. / There are two different modes. / E-MODE (CHAMPIONS MODE) is for two to four players, each with a Emerald Champions Game Pak. / G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is only for four players, each with a POKéMON Emerald Champions, Ruby, or Sapphire. / The players should discuss which mode they want, then choose the same mode. / Once all the players have chosen the same CONTEST in the same mode, the entry registration is complete. / After that, a CONTEST will start in the usual manner.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
text: In E-MODE (CHAMPIONS MODE), a LINK CONTEST can be held with two to four players. Each player must have an Emerald Champions Game Pak. / The players must be linked with each other using Wireless Adapters or GBA Game Link cables. / If there are fewer than four players, TRAINERS in the hall will join to fill the 4-player CONTEST lineup. / Please be aware that E-MODE is not available in POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode

label: Text_ProfileSaysSomethingAboutYou
text: Hmhm… / Your profile really says something about who you are. / Now that I know you better, it  makes us better friends than ever!$

label: Text_HeardThatBefore
text: Oh, I've heard that before… / My cousin, who lives far away, always used to say that, I think.$

label: Text_TellMoreNextTime
text: Please tell me more about yourself next time!$

label: Text_VoiceRangOutDontRunAway
text: Someone's voice rang out, “Don't run away!”$

label: ProfileMan_Text_CollectTrainerProfiles
text: Hello there, TRAINER! You've got a wonderful smile, there. / I have a hobby--collecting the profiles of POKéMON TRAINERS.$

label: ProfileMan_Text_MayISeeYourProfile
text: So, how about it? May I see your profile?$

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
text: You make your own profile by putting together four words or phrases. / Here, I'll show you an example of a profile using four pieces of text. / You can switch those four pieces with other text pieces any which way you like to make your own profile. / There are a lot of text pieces that you can use. / They are arranged in groups like POKéMON, lifestyles, and hobbies so it is easier to look them up. / So, first, choose the group of text pieces to display a list of choices. / Then, pick the choice you want. / Repeat for the remaining text choices, and you'll have your very own profile.$

label: ProfileMan_Text_LetsSeeItThen
text: Yes! Thank you! So, let's see it, then.$

label: ProfileMan_Text_ImagineYouWouldHaveWonderfulProfile
text: Oh, no, really? / I imagine someone like you would have a wonderful profile…$

label: ProfileMan_Text_NotIntoItRightNow
text: Oh? You're not into it right now? / Well, anytime is good by me!$

label: ProfileMan_Text_YouHaveWonderfulSmile
text: Hello there, TRAINER! You've got a wonderful smile.$

label: ProfileMan_Text_MayISeeYourNewProfile
text: May I see your new profile?$

label: ProfileMan_Text_EvenBetterThanLastProfile
text: Yes! Thank you! / I hope it's even better than the profile you showed me before.$

label: ProfileMan_Text_LikeProfileWayItIs
text: Oh, you like your profile the way it is. / I don't blame you--it's a wonderful profile the way it is now.$

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile
text: F-fantastic! / Your profile, it's wonderful! It really says what you're about. / Why, anyone hearing this profile would be captivated by you! / Thank you!$

label: ProfileMan_Text_YouKnowSecretSaying
text: Oh? You know the secret saying! / That means you're now a fellow member of the MYSTERY EVENT CLUB!$

label: SafariZone_Text_WouldYouLikeToExit
text: Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE right now?$

label: SafariZone_Text_TimesUp
text: Ding-dong! Time's up! Your SAFARI Game is over.$

label: SafariZone_Text_OutOfBalls
text: You've run out of SAFARI BALLS. Your SAFARI Game is over.$

label: SafariZone_Text_PlacePokeblockOnFeeder

label: SafariZone_Text_PokeblockWasPlaced

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
text: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE! / Here, you may witness many kinds of POKéMON rarely seen in HOENN. / And, you'll see them in their wild, untamed state in natural habitats. / What's more, we've thrown open the gates to POKéMON TRAINERS. / You're encouraged to catch POKéMON for keeps! / Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeFirstTime
text: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE! Is it your first time here?$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ComeInAndEnjoy
text: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
text: When you enter the SAFARI ZONE, you start with 30 SAFARI BALLS for catching POKéMON. / The SAFARI Game is over when you run out of SAFARI BALLS, or when you've walked 500 steps. / Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WouldYouLikeToPlay
text: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE! / All you can catch for just ¥500! Would you like to play a SAFARI Game?$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PlayAnotherTime
text: Okay. Please play another time!$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_NotEnoughMoney
text: You don't have enough money. Sorry.$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ThatWillBe500Please
text: That will be ¥500, please.$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_HereAreYourSafariBalls
text: Here are your SAFARI BALLS.$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Received30SafariBalls
text: {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS.$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
text: We'll let you know when your game is over. / So, until then, enjoy yourself, please! Off you go on your wild excursion!$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PCIsFull
text: Excuse me! Your PC BOX is full.$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
text: Excuse me! You seem to be without a {POKEBLOCK} CASE. / Your SAFARI Game will be much more fruitful if you use {POKEBLOCK}S. / Please come back with a {POKEBLOCK} CASE. / You may obtain a {POKEBLOCK} CASE from the LILYCOVE CONTEST HALL.$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_StillHaveTimeExit
text: You still have time left. Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE now?$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_EnjoyTheRestOfYourAdventure
text: Please enjoy the rest of your wild adventure!$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
text: Okay. / I'll take back your remaining SAFARI BALLS. / Thank you for playing. We hope to see you again.$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
text: Good luck! / If you need anything, don't hesitate to tell me, please!$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
text: Did you know? / If you put a {POKEBLOCK} in that square box, POKéMON gather around.$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
text: I want to keep going deeper, but I forgot to bring a BIKE. / Something tells me that rare POKéMON live in the outlying areas.$

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
text: Sometimes, when I toss a {POKEBLOCK} at  POKéMON, it gets ignored. / Do POKéMON have likes and dislikes about what they eat?$

label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
text: Gasp… Gasp… I…made it out here…but… / I'm exhausted… I don't have the energy to catch POKéMON…$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
text: I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON you don't see in HOENN. / Do you have any idea where the lake is?$

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Man
text: I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON here and trade them with my friends!$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
text: I put a {POKEBLOCK} on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER. But it seems to have disappeared. / I guess POKéMON must have eaten it without me noticing.$

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
text: SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP! / Throw {POKEBLOCK}S at wild POKéMON to make them less likely to flee.$

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_RestHouseSign
text: “Relieve your tired feet.” REST HOUSE$

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
text: I don't have any {POKEBLOCK}S, but I caught a good number of POKéMON. / You can improve your chances of making a catch by getting closer to them before throwing a SAFARI BALL.$

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
text: If you use {POKEBLOCK}S, wild POKéMON won't be so quick to run away. / It's not much use to give {POKEBLOCK}S to POKéMON that don't flee easily. / Looking for Alolan forms? RAICHU lives in the south. EXEGGUTOR lives in the north and northwest; MAROWAK, north.$

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
text: If you put a {POKEBLOCK} on the FEEDER, POKéMON are attracted to it. / I think POKéMON with the same sort of nature are drawn by a certain {POKEBLOCK}.$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits1
text: This area is still under construction. It's off-limits, sorry!$

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFinished
text: The SAFARI ZONE's expansion project is finished now. / We hope you will enjoy the new area.$

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits2
text: This area is still under construction. It's off-limits, sorry!$

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_LittleGirl
text: Wow! Whee! I haven't seen any of these POKéMON before!$

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan
text: The POKéMON in this area are all new to me. / And I'm allowed to catch these rare POKéMON! Too cool!$

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_RichBoy
text: The POKéMON around here seem to be from somewhere other than HOENN.$

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy
text: I only have a couple SAFARI BALLS left. / I'm having a hard time trying to decide what I should catch.$

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Woman
text: I heard that you can see PIKACHU here. Where might one be?$

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl
text: Oh, boo! I can't seem to catch anything! / I'll end up wasting the admission price if I don't catch something!$
